title.zh: 卷236 列傳二十三 陈泰 阿尔津 李国翰 卓布泰 卓罗 爱星阿 逊塔
title.en: Volume 236 Biographies 23: Chen Tai, A Er Jin, Li Guohan, Zhuo Butai, Zhuo Luo, Ai Xing A, Xun Ta
title.raw: 卷236 列傳二十三 陈泰 阿尔津 李国翰 卓布泰 卓罗 爱星阿 逊塔

sentences.zh: 陳泰阿爾津李國翰卓布泰卓羅愛星阿遜塔

translations.literal: Chen Tai, Arjin, Li Guohan, Zhuobutai, Zhuoluo, Aixing'a, Xunta
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tai, Arjin, Li Guohan, Zhuobutai, Zhuoluo, Aixing'a, and Xunta

sentences.zh: 陳泰，滿洲鑲黃旗人，額亦都孫，徹爾格子也。

translations.literal: Chen Tai was a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, grandson of Eidu, and son of Cherge.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tai was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, a grandson of Eidu and a son of Cherge.

sentences.zh: 初授巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed a Baya-i Jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed commander of a vanguard company.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，攻錦州，明兵自寧遠來援。

translations.literal: He followed in the campaign against Ming, attacked Jinzhou, and Ming troops came from Ningyuan to relieve the city.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the campaign against the Ming and attacked Jinzhou; Ming forces came from Ningyuan to relieve the siege.

sentences.zh: 陳泰先眾直入敵陣，斬執纛者，得纛以歸。

translations.literal: Chen Tai went ahead of the troops straight into the enemy formation, killed the banner-bearer, and returned with the banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tai led the way into the enemy line, slew the man carrying the standard, and brought the banner back.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從太宗伐明，薄明都，屯德勝門外，攻袁崇煥壘，遇伏，奮擊，多所俘馘​​。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, he followed the Taizong in campaigning against Ming, approached the Ming capital, encamped outside Desheng Gate, attacked Yuan Chonghuan's fortifications, met an ambush, fought fiercely, and took many captives and heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Tiancong reign he followed the Taizong against the Ming, drew near the capital, and camped outside Desheng Gate. Attacking Yuan Chonghuan's works, he ran into an ambush but fought hard and took many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍大凌河城，明監軍道張春赴援，陳泰設伏，擒其邏卒，復以步軍戰，殲敵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he joined the siege of Dalinghe; Ming supervising commissioner Zhang Chun came to relieve the city; Chen Tai laid an ambush, captured enemy scouts, then fought again with infantry and annihilated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Dalinghe. When the Ming supervising commissioner Zhang Chun marched to relieve the city, Chen Tai set an ambush, seized enemy scouts, fought on with infantry, and destroyed the relief force.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮，與梅勒額真薩穆什喀夜襲破黃州守將營。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, he joined the campaign against Korea; with meirei janggin Samushka he launched a night attack that broke the garrison camp of the defending general at Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde he joined the invasion of Korea. With meirei janggin Samushka he made a night assault that overran the defending general's camp at Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，伐明，敗明兵於豐潤，攻太監馮永盛、總兵侯世祿營，拔之；

translations.literal: In the third year, campaigning against Ming, he defeated Ming troops at Fengrun, attacked the camps of eunuch Feng Yongsheng and regional commander Hou Shilu, and took them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on campaign against the Ming, he routed Ming forces at Fengrun and stormed the camps of the eunuch Feng Yongsheng and regional commander Hou Shilu.

sentences.zh: 又以巴牙喇兵三十敗明騎卒百餘。

translations.literal: He also with thirty vanguard troops defeated more than a hundred Ming cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: With only thirty vanguard troops he also routed more than a hundred Ming horsemen.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍錦州，攻杏山，敗敵兵，獲牲畜。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he joined the siege of Jinzhou, attacked Xingshan, defeated enemy troops, and seized livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Jinzhou, attacked Xingshan, defeated the enemy, and captured livestock.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，敗松山兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he again besieged Jinzhou and defeated the Songshan troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again invested Jinzhou and defeated the Songshan garrison.

sentences.zh: 我兵出樵採，為敵困，陳泰率兵六援之出，敵襲我後隊，迭戰破敵，遂克其郛。

translations.literal: Our troops went out to gather firewood and were trapped by the enemy; Chen Tai led six companies to rescue them; the enemy attacked our rear guard; fighting in succession he broke the enemy and then took their outer wall.
translations.idiomatic: When our men went out for firewood and were surrounded, Chen Tai led six companies to extricate them. The enemy struck our rear, but after successive engagements he broke them and captured the outer rampart.

sentences.zh: 予世職，自牛錄章京進三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He was granted a hereditary office and advanced from niru janggin to third-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He received a hereditary rank and was promoted from company commander to third-rank battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，复圍錦州，掘塹困松山。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he again besieged Jinzhou and dug trenches to hem in Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he again besieged Jinzhou and dug trenches to pin down Songshan.

sentences.zh: 明兵夜犯正黃旗蒙古營，赴援，擊之走。

translations.literal: Ming troops attacked the Mongol camp of the Plain Yellow Banner by night; he went to relieve it and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces raided the Mongol camp of the Plain Yellow Banner at night, he went to its aid and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，敗總兵馬科於渾河，築浮橋濟師。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he joined the campaign against Ming, defeated regional commander Ma Ke at the Hun River, and built a pontoon bridge to ferry the army across.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the Ming campaign, defeated regional commander Ma Ke at the Hun River, and threw a pontoon bridge across for the army.

sentences.zh: 明總督范志完拒戰，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Ming governor-general Fan Zhiwan resisted in battle and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming governor-general Fan Zhiwan gave battle, Chen Tai defeated him.

sentences.zh: 下山東，陳泰以偏師克東阿、汶上、寧陽三縣，進世職二等。

translations.literal: The army descended into Shandong; Chen Tai with a detached force took the three counties of Dong'e, Wenshang, and Ningyang, and his hereditary rank was advanced to the second degree.
translations.idiomatic: As the army moved into Shandong, Chen Tai with a detached column captured Dong'e, Wenshang, and Ningyang, and his hereditary rank rose to the second degree.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊破李自成，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed the entry through the passes, defeated Li Zicheng, and his hereditary rank was advanced to the first degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he marched through the passes into China, routed Li Zicheng, and was raised to a first-degree hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made vice minister of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 從平南大將軍孔有德徵湖廣，戰荊州，擊破流賊一隻虎。

translations.literal: He followed Pacification-of-the-South Grand General Kong Youde in campaigning in Huguang, fought at Jingzhou, and defeated the bandit known as One-Eyed Tiger.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Grand General Kong Youde's Huguang campaign, fought at Jingzhou, and broke the bandit leader known as One-Eyed Tiger.

sentences.zh: 時明魯王遣其將鄭彩、阮進等寇福建，先後陷府三、州一、縣二十七。

translations.literal: At that time the Ming Prince of Lu sent his generals Zheng Cai, Ruan Jin, and others to raid Fujian; they successively took three prefectures, one subprefecture, and twenty-seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Ming Prince of Lu sent Zheng Cai, Ruan Jin, and other generals against Fujian, and they in turn seized three prefectures, one subprefecture, and twenty-seven counties.

sentences.zh: 上授陳泰靖南將軍，與梅勒額真棟阿賚率師討之，擊破魯王將曹大鎬、張耀星，克同安、平和二縣。

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Chen Tai Pacifier of the South general and, with meirei janggin Dong'ai, led troops to suppress them; he defeated the Prince of Lu's generals Cao Dagao and Zhang Yaoxing and took the two counties of Tong'an and Pinghe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor named Chen Tai Pacifier of the South and, with meirei janggin Dong'ai, marched against them. He defeated the Prince of Lu's generals Cao Dagao and Zhang Yaoxing and recovered Tong'an and Pinghe.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，复克興化。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, he again took Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year he retook Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 彩遁入海，复克長樂、連江，獲所置總督顧世臣等十一人，斬之。

translations.literal: Cai fled to the sea; he again took Changle and Lianjiang, captured eleven men including the governor they had installed, Gu Shichen, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Cai fled to sea. Chen Tai retook Changle and Lianjiang, seized eleven men including the puppet governor Gu Shichen, and had them executed.

sentences.zh: 魯王所陷諸府州縣以次盡复，福建平。

translations.literal: The prefectures, subprefectures, and counties taken by the Prince of Lu were all recovered in turn, and Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures, subprefectures, and counties the Prince of Lu had seized were recovered one after another, and Fujian was pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，授巴牙喇纛章京，進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was appointed Baya-i banner janggin and advanced to second-rank ashan iha'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was made commander of the vanguard banner and advanced to second-rank ashan iha'an.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，累進三等精奇尼哈番兼拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: On receiving an amnesty edict, he was repeatedly advanced to third-rank jingkini ha'an together with baitalaburu ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: Under successive amnesty promotions he rose to third-rank jingkini ha'an with the additional rank of baitalaburu ha'an.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be minister of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to minister of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 八年，移吏部尚書，授國史院大學士。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was moved to minister of the Ministry of Personnel and appointed grand secretary of the Historiography Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became minister of the Ministry of Personnel and was appointed a grand secretary of the Historiography Academy.

sentences.zh: 以加上皇太后尊號恩詔誤增赦款罷任，並以吏部覃恩升襲過濫，降世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Because in the amnesty edict for adding the honorific title to the empress dowager he had wrongly added extra pardon clauses, he was dismissed from office; and because promotions and inheritances in the Ministry of Personnel under the general amnesty were excessive, his hereditary rank was reduced one degree to adaha ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for having wrongly broadened the pardon clauses in the edict honoring the empress dowager, and because the Ministry of Personnel had been too lavish in promotions and inheritances under the general amnesty, his hereditary rank was cut one degree to adaha ha'an.

sentences.zh: 九年，起禮部尚書，充會試主考官，授鑲黃旗滿洲固山額真，特命進世職二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was recalled as minister of the Ministry of Rites, served as chief examiner for the metropolitan examinations, was appointed gushan ejen of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and by special order his hereditary rank was advanced to second-degree jingkini ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was recalled as minister of rites, served as chief metropolitan examiner, was made banner commander of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and by special order was raised to second-degree jingkini ha'an.

sentences.zh: 十年，上以湖廣未定，大學士洪承疇再出經略，至軍，疏言：「孫可望等戰湖南，郝搖旗、一隻虎等擾湖北。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because Huguang was still unsettled, Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou again went out as supreme commander; reaching the army, he memorialized: "Sun Kewang and others are fighting in Hunan, while Hao Yaoqi, One-Eyed Tiger, and others are harassing Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, with Huguang still unsettled, Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou took the field again as supreme commander. On reaching the army he wrote: "Sun Kewang and others are active in Hunan, while Hao Yaoqi, One-Eyed Tiger, and others are raiding Hubei.

sentences.zh: 湖南駐重兵，各郡窵遠，不免首尾難顧。」

translations.literal: Hunan holds heavy forces, yet the prefectures are widely scattered, so one cannot avoid being unable to attend to both ends."
translations.idiomatic: Heavy forces are posted in Hunan, but the prefectures lie far apart, so it is hard to guard both flanks at once."

sentences.zh: 上授陳泰宁南靖寇大將軍，與固山額真藍拜、濟席哈，巴牙喇纛章京蘇克薩哈等統兵鎮湖南。

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Chen Tai Grand General for Pacifying the South and Suppressing Bandits, and with gushan ejen Lanbai, Jisihai, Baya-i banner janggin Suksaha, and others he commanded troops to garrison Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor named Chen Tai Grand General for Pacifying the South and Suppressing Bandits and, with gushan ejen Lanbai, Jisihai, vanguard banner commander Suksaha, and others, stationed an army in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 臨行，上諭之曰：「師行有一定紀律，大小將佐，為國盡力，豈致挫釁？

translations.literal: On his departure the emperor instructed him: "An army on campaign has fixed discipline; officers great and small should exert themselves for the state—how could they cause setbacks?
translations.idiomatic: Before he left, the emperor told him: "An army on the march lives by fixed discipline. Every officer, high or low, must give his utmost for the state—how could there be setbacks?

sentences.zh: 上毋藐視主帥，下當撫勵士卒，能愛眾而得其心，遇敵未有不爭先效命者也。」

translations.literal: Those above must not despise the commander; those below should encourage the soldiers; if one can cherish the troops and win their hearts, when meeting the enemy there has never been one who did not strive to be first in giving his life."
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates must not slight their commander, and leaders must hearten their men. Win the soldiers' hearts by caring for them, and in battle they will always rush forward to give their lives."

sentences.zh: 十一年，复授吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was again appointed minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was again made minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 十二年，孫可望遣其將劉文秀、盧明臣、馮雙禮等以舟師六萬分犯岳州、武昌。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Sun Kewang sent his generals Liu Wenxiu, Lu Mingchen, Feng Shuangli, and others with a fleet of sixty thousand to attack Yuezhou and Wuchang in separate columns.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Sun Kewang sent Liu Wenxiu, Lu Mingchen, Feng Shuangli, and other generals with sixty thousand men in river craft to strike Yuezhou and Wuchang in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 文秀引精兵攻常德，陳泰遣蘇克薩哈設伏以待。

translations.literal: Wenxiu led elite troops to attack Changde; Chen Tai sent Suksaha to lay an ambush and wait.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiu led picked troops against Changde; Chen Tai sent Suksaha to set an ambush.

sentences.zh: 甲喇額真呼尼牙羅和當前鋒，挫敵；

translations.literal: Jalan ejen Honiyaluohe served as vanguard and checked the enemy;
translations.idiomatic: Jalan ejen Honiyaluohe took the van and blunted the enemy attack;

sentences.zh: 甲喇額真蘇拜、希福等以舟師迎擊；

translations.literal: jalan ejen Subai, Xifu, and others met them with the river fleet;
translations.idiomatic: jalan ejen Subai, Xifu, and others engaged them with the fleet;

sentences.zh: 大軍繼進，三合三勝。

translations.literal: the main army followed up, and in three engagements they won three victories.
translations.idiomatic: and when the main force came up, three clashes brought three victories.

sentences.zh: 敵复列艦拒戰，伏起，縱火焚其舟，敵大敗，別遣兵擊敵德山下。

translations.literal: The enemy again lined up their ships to resist; the ambush rose, fire was set and their boats burned; the enemy suffered a great defeat, and separate troops were sent to strike the enemy below Deshan.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy formed their ships again, the ambush sprang up, torches were thrown, and their fleet burned. The enemy were routed, and a detachment was sent to strike them below Deshan.

sentences.zh: 師進次龍陽，敵集二千人來犯，我兵奮擊，潰奔，明臣赴水死。

translations.literal: The army advanced and encamped at Longyang; the enemy gathered two thousand men to attack; our troops fought fiercely, they broke and fled, and Mingchen drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: The army moved on to Longyang. Two thousand enemy troops gathered to attack, but our men fought hard and put them to flight; Mingchen drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 雙禮被創，與文秀並遁。

translations.literal: Shuangli was wounded and fled together with Wenxiu.
translations.idiomatic: Shuangli was wounded and fled with Wenxiu.

sentences.zh: 降所置裨將四十餘、兵三千餘。

translations.literal: More than forty deputy generals they had installed and more than three thousand soldiers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty of their appointed deputy generals and more than three thousand troops surrendered.

sentences.zh: 論功，進一等精奇尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In reckoning merit, he was advanced to first-rank jingkini ha'an together with tosoro ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was raised to first-rank jingkini ha'an with the additional rank of tosoro ha'an.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒於軍。

translations.literal: Before long, he died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died in camp.

sentences.zh: 師還，明年正月，世祖宴諸將，追悼陳泰，揮淚酌酒，諭學士麻勒吉、侍衛覺羅塔大曰：「大將軍班師還，朕將親酌酒以慰勞之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, in the first month of the following year the Shizu emperor feasted the generals, mourned Chen Tai, wiped away tears as he poured wine, and instructed academician Meleji and guard Gioro Tada: "When the grand general returns victorious, I was going to pour wine myself to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned, in the first month of the next year the Shizu emperor held a feast for his generals. Mourning Chen Tai, he poured wine with tears in his eyes and told academician Meleji and guard Gioro Tada: "When the grand general came home victorious, I meant to pour his wine myself.

sentences.zh: 不幸中道棄捐，不復相見。

translations.literal: Alas, midway he was taken from us and we shall not meet again.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, he was taken on the road and we shall never meet again.

sentences.zh: 爾等以此觴奠大將軍靈次，抒朕追悼。」

translations.literal: You are to offer this cup before the grand general's spirit tablet and express my mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Take this cup to his spirit tablet and speak my grief for me."

sentences.zh: 諸將及侍從皆感涕。

translations.literal: All the generals and attendants were moved to tears.
translations.idiomatic: Every general and attendant wept.

sentences.zh: 賜祭葬，諡忠襄。

translations.literal: Sacrificial rites and burial were granted, and the posthumous title Zhongxiang was given.
translations.idiomatic: State sacrifices and burial were granted, with the posthumous title Loyal and Assisting.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: Early in the Qianlong reign, his enfeoffment was fixed as first-rank zi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign his line was fixed at first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 阿爾津，伊爾根覺羅氏。

translations.literal: Arjin was of the Irgen Gioro clan.
translations.idiomatic: Arjin was of the Irgen Gioro clan.

sentences.zh: 父齊瑪塔，與從子阿山歸太祖，官侍衛。

translations.literal: His father Qimata, together with his nephew's son Ashan, submitted to the Taizu and served as guards.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qimata came over to the Taizu with his nephew Ashan and served as imperial guards.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，與阿山同隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: When the banners were fixed, he and Ashan were both registered in the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was set, he and Ashan were both placed in the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 阿山自有傳。

translations.literal: Ashan has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Ashan has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 阿爾津積戰功，授甲喇額真，世職二等參將。

translations.literal: Arjin accumulated battle merit, was appointed jalan ejen, and held a hereditary second-rank brigade-general's office.
translations.idiomatic: Through repeated battlefield service Arjin was made jalan ejen with a hereditary second-rank brigade-general's rank.

sentences.zh: 天聰四年，從固山額真納穆泰等守灤州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancong, he followed gushan ejen Namutai and others in defending Luanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tiancong he joined gushan ejen Namutai in holding Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 納穆泰等引還，論罪，上以阿爾津力戰殺敵，特貰之。

translations.literal: Namutai and others led the troops back and were judged guilty; the emperor, because Arjin had fought fiercely and killed the enemy, specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Namutai and the others withdrew and were found guilty, but because Arjin had fought hard and killed many of the enemy, the emperor specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 九年，伐察哈爾，阿爾津從貝勒岳託駐歸化城。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, campaigning against the Chahar, Arjin followed Prince Yuetuo and garrisoned Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on the Chahar campaign, Arjin followed Prince Yuetuo and was posted at Guihuacheng.

sentences.zh: 博碩克圖汗子陰結喀爾喀等部貳於明，阿爾津獲其使者，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: The son of Bogd Setsen Khan had secretly joined the Khalkha and other tribes in defecting to Ming; Arjin captured his envoy and his hereditary rank was advanced to first-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: The son of Bogd Setsen Khan had secretly induced the Khalkha and other tribes to side with the Ming; Arjin seized his envoy and was raised to first-rank battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，上自將伐朝鮮，朝鮮國王李倧走南漢山城，阿爾津簡精騎追躡，破其援兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, the emperor personally led the campaign against Korea; the Korean king Li Jong fled to Namhansanseong; Arjin selected elite cavalry to pursue, and defeated his relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde the emperor led the invasion of Korea in person. When King Li Jong fled to Namhansanseong, Arjin took picked cavalry in pursuit and routed his relief force.

sentences.zh: 二年，略鐵山，獲明邏卒。

translations.literal: In the second year, he raided Tieshan and captured Ming scouts.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he raided Tieshan and took Ming scouts prisoner.

sentences.zh: 授議政大臣，領巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: He was appointed a deliberative minister and placed in charge of the Baya-i banner janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He was made a deliberative minister and commander of the vanguard banner.

sentences.zh: 三年，從豫親王多鐸伐明，過中後所，明將祖大壽發兵追襲，阿爾津為殿，戰不力，所部多戰死者，又棄其骨不收，坐削世職，籍家產之半，仍領巴牙喇纛章京如故。

translations.literal: In the third year, he followed Prince Dorgon of Yu in campaigning against Ming; passing Zhonghousuo, Ming general Zu Dashi sent troops in pursuit; Arjin served as rearguard, fought poorly, and many of his men were killed in battle; he also abandoned their bones without collecting them; he was punished by reduction of hereditary rank and confiscation of half his household property, yet still commanded the Baya-i banner janggin as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Dorgon against the Ming. At Zhonghousuo the Ming general Zu Dashi pursued them, and Arjin, commanding the rearguard, fought poorly; many of his men fell, and he left their bones unburied. His hereditary rank was cut and half his property confiscated, but he retained command of the vanguard banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍錦州，以離城遠駐，坐罰鍰。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he joined the siege of Jinzhou; because he encamped too far from the city, he was fined.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Jinzhou but was fined for pitching camp too far from the walls.

sentences.zh: 六年，攻松山，擊明總督洪承疇軍，克台一、壘三，殲守台敵兵，出我師被圍者。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, attacking Songshan, he struck the army of Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou, took one redoubt and three forts, annihilated the enemy defending the redoubts, and extricated our surrounded troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, assaulting Songshan, he hit Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou's army, captured one redoubt and three forts, wiped out the garrisons, and rescued our encircled men.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其善戰，复授三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his skill in battle and again appointed him third-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his fighting and restored him to third-rank battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，從伐明，攻寧遠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he joined the campaign against Ming and attacked Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined the Ming campaign and attacked Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 八年，與巴牙喇纛章京哈寧阿等伐虎爾哈部，下七屯，俘獲無算。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, with Baya-i banner janggin Haning'a and others he campaigned against the Hurha tribes, took seven settlements, and captured booty beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he campaigned against the Hurha with vanguard commander Haning'a and others, overran seven settlements, and took countless prisoners and spoils.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，追及於安肅，大破之，進二等甲喇章京，兼半個前程。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed the entry through the passes, attacked Li Zicheng, overtook him at Ansu, inflicted a great defeat, and was advanced to second-rank jalan janggin with half a qian-cheng stipend.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he marched through the passes, struck Li Zicheng, caught him at Ansu, and routed him. He was raised to second-rank battalion commander with half a qian-cheng stipend.

sentences.zh: 尋從豫親王多鐸西破潼關，還定江南，進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Soon after he followed Prince Dorgon of Yu in breaking Tong Pass in the west, returned to pacify Jiangnan, and was advanced to third-rank meirei janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Prince Dorgon west to break Tong Pass and helped pacify Jiangnan, rising to third-rank meirei janggin.

sentences.zh: 三年，與巴牙喇纛章京鰲拜等徇漢中，擊叛將賀珍，破流賊張獻忠，進攻敘州，所向克捷。

translations.literal: In the third year, with Baya-i banner janggin Oboi and others he campaigned in Hanzhong, attacked the rebel general He Zhen, defeated the bandit Zhang Xianzhong, advanced on Xuzhou, and wherever he went achieved victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he campaigned in Hanzhong with vanguard commander Oboi and others, struck the rebel He Zhen, broke Zhang Xianzhong's band, and advanced on Xuzhou, winning wherever he fought.

sentences.zh: 五年，進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was advanced to first-rank ashan iha'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was raised to first-rank ashan iha'an.

sentences.zh: 尋率師定宣化叛兵。

translations.literal: Soon after he led troops to pacify the rebel soldiers at Xuanhua.
translations.idiomatic: He then led troops to put down the mutiny at Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 八年，與固山額真額克青等發武英親王阿濟格罪狀，語詳阿濟格傳。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, with gushan ejen Ekeqing and others he exposed the crimes of Prince Ajige of Ying; the details are given in Ajige's biography.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined gushan ejen Ekeqing in exposing the crimes of Prince Ajige of Ying; the full account is in Ajige's biography.

sentences.zh: 敘功，遇恩詔，進一等精奇尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In reckoning merit, on receiving an amnesty edict he was advanced to first-rank jingkini ha'an together with tosoro ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: For his services, and under an amnesty edict, he was raised to first-rank jingkini ha'an with the additional rank of tosoro ha'an.

sentences.zh: 九年，授西安將軍，鎮漢中。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was appointed general of Xi'an and garrisoned Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made general of Xi'an and posted to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 尋改授定南將軍，移師徇湖廣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to be Pacifier of the South general and moved his army to campaign in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Pacifier of the South and moved his army into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十一年，自巴牙喇纛章京遷固山額真。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was transferred from Baya-i banner janggin to gushan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted from vanguard banner commander to banner commander.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，授寧南靖​​寇大將軍，與固山額真卓羅等率師駐荊州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, he was appointed Grand General for Pacifying the South and Suppressing Bandits, and with gushan ejen Zhuoluo and others led troops stationed at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year he was named Grand General for Pacifying the South and Suppressing Bandits and, with gushan ejen Zhuoluo and others, garrisoned Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時土寇姚黃等據歸州，出沒宜昌、襄陽間，阿爾津督兵搜捕，安集兵民，枝江、松滋諸縣悉定。

translations.literal: At that time the local bandits Yao Huang and others held Guizhou and ranged between Yichang and Xiangyang; Arjin directed troops in search and capture, settled soldiers and civilians, and the counties of Zhijiang, Songzi, and others were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Local bandits led by Yao Huang held Guizhou and raided between Yichang and Xiangyang. Arjin hunted them down, resettled soldiers and civilians, and pacified Zhijiang, Songzi, and the other counties.

sentences.zh: 十三年，與卓羅等率師渡江，十月，克辰州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, with Zhuoluo and others he led troops across the river; in the tenth month he took Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he crossed the river with Zhuoluo and others and took Chenzhou in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 寶慶、永順諸土司率官吏，具版籍，詣軍前降。

translations.literal: The native officials of Baojing, Yongshun, and other chieftaincies led their civil officers, brought their registers, and came before the army to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The chiefs of Baojing, Yongshun, and other domains brought their officials and household registers to surrender before the army.

sentences.zh: 時雲南、貴州尚為明守，阿爾津議移常德鎮兵守辰州，別移兵屯常德為應援，自辰州下沅、靖，進取滇、黔。

translations.literal: At that time Yunnan and Guizhou were still held by Ming forces; Arjin proposed moving the Changde garrison to hold Chenzhou, shifting other troops to encamp at Changde as reinforcement, and from Chenzhou descending along the Yuan and Jing rivers to advance on Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan and Guizhou were still in Ming hands. Arjin proposed shifting the Changde garrison to Chenzhou, posting another force at Changde as reserve, and advancing down the Yuan and Jing rivers from Chenzhou into Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士洪承疇與異議，事聞，上召阿爾津還京師，以宗室羅託代之。

translations.literal: Supreme commander Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou disagreed; when the matter was reported, the emperor summoned Arjin back to the capital and replaced him with the imperial clansman Luotuo.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme commander Hong Chengchou disagreed. When word reached the throne, the emperor recalled Arjin to the capital and sent the imperial clansman Luotuo in his place.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，授信郡王多尼為安遠靖寇大將軍，徵雲南，命阿爾津率本旗兵以從。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year, Prince Xin of the Faithful Domain Duoni was appointed Grand General for Pacifying the Distant Regions and Suppressing Bandits to campaign in Yunnan, and Arjin was ordered to lead his banner troops to follow.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year Prince Duoni of the Faithful Domain was named Grand General for Pacifying the Distant Regions and Suppressing Bandits for the Yunnan campaign, and Arjin was ordered to bring his banner troops with him.

sentences.zh: 五月，卒於軍，贈太子太保，諡端果。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, he died in the army; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Duanguo.
translations.idiomatic: He died in camp in the fifth month and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the title Upright and Resolute.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等子。

translations.literal: Early in the Qianlong reign, his enfeoffment was fixed as third-rank zi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign his line was fixed at third-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 李國翰，漢軍鑲藍旗人，其先居清河。

translations.literal: Li Guohan was a man of the Han Bordered Blue Banner; his ancestors had lived in Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guohan was a Han bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner; his family had long lived in Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 父繼學，初為商，從明經略楊鎬軍，嘗通使於我。

translations.literal: His father Jixue had first been a merchant, followed the army of Ming supreme commander Yang Hao, and had once sent envoys to us.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jixue had been a merchant before joining the army of the Ming supreme commander Yang Hao and had once sent envoys to our side.

sentences.zh: 天命六年，克遼陽，繼學來歸，授都司。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianming, when Liaoyang was taken, Jixue came over and was appointed a regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Liaoyang fell in the sixth year of Tianming, Jixue submitted and was made a regional commander.

sentences.zh: 以副將劉興祚婪賄，劾罷之。

translations.literal: Because vice commander Liu Xingzuo had been greedy for bribes, he impeached and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached and removed vice commander Liu Xingzuo for taking bribes.

sentences.zh: 屢獲明諜，捕逃人，授世職三等副將。

translations.literal: He repeatedly captured Ming spies and seized fugitives, and was granted a hereditary third-rank vice commander's office.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly captured Ming spies and runaways and received a hereditary third-rank vice commander's rank.

sentences.zh: 請老，國翰襲世職。

translations.literal: He requested retirement on grounds of age, and Guohan inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: When he retired on grounds of age, Guohan inherited the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，授侍衛，賜號「墨爾根」。

translations.literal: Serving the Taizong, he was appointed a guard and granted the title "Mergen."
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taizong he became an imperial guard and was given the sobriquet "Mergen."

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從伐明，薄明都。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, he joined the campaign against Ming and approached the Ming capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiancong he joined the Ming campaign and drew near the capital.

sentences.zh: 還攻永平，戰先眾。

translations.literal: On the return march he attacked Yongping and fought ahead of the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the way back he attacked Yongping and fought in the van.

sentences.zh: 五年，圍大凌河，城兵突出，國翰督兵擊之退；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, besieging Dalinghe, the garrison sallied forth; Guohan directed troops and drove them back;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, during the siege of Dalinghe, the garrison sallied out; Guohan led troops and beat them back;

sentences.zh: 明兵自錦州赴援，又擊之，敗走。

translations.literal: Ming troops came from Jinzhou to relieve the city; he attacked them again and they were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: when Ming relief came from Jinzhou he struck them again and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 九年，以善拊循所領人戶，進世職二等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because he was skilled in comforting and guiding the households under his command, his hereditary rank was advanced to second-rank meirei janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, for his skill in caring for the households under his command, he was raised to second-rank meirei janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, he was appointed an administrative officer of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was made an administrative officer of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，入邊，明兵千餘據山列陣，國翰督兵奮擊，敗之，獲馬四十；

translations.literal: Joining the campaign against Ming and entering the frontier, more than a thousand Ming troops held the mountain in battle formation; Guohan directed troops in fierce attack, defeated them, and captured forty horses;
translations.idiomatic: On the Ming campaign he crossed the frontier. When more than a thousand Ming troops formed up on a hill, Guohan led a fierce assault, routed them, and seized forty horses;

sentences.zh: 進克牆子嶺，轉戰至山東，克濟南。

translations.literal: he advanced and took Qiangziling, fought on into Shandong, and took Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: then took Qiangziling, fought through into Shandong, and captured Jinan.

sentences.zh: 師還，攻慶都、獲鹿，發砲毀其垣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he attacked Qingdu and Huolu and fired cannon that destroyed their walls.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he attacked Qingdu and Huolu and battered their walls with cannon.

sentences.zh: 四年，授鑲藍旗漢軍梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was appointed meirei ejen of the Han Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made meirei ejen of the Han Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，從攻錦州，克呂洪山台。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he joined the attack on Jinzhou and took the Lühongshan redoubt.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the assault on Jinzhou and captured the Lühongshan redoubt.

sentences.zh: 七年，攻下塔山、杏山，擢鑲藍旗漢軍固山額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he took Tashan and Xingshan and was promoted to gushan ejen of the Han Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he took Tashan and Xingshan and was promoted to banner commander of the Han Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，從克前屯衛、中後所。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he joined in taking Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he helped capture Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 世職累進三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to third-rank amban janggin.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank rose in stages to third-rank amban janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，國翰與固山額真劉之源、祖澤潤等率兵剿饒陽土寇康文鬥、郭壯畿等，師進徵山西。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, following the entry through the passes, Guohan with gushan ejen Liu Zhiyuan, Zu Zerun, and others led troops to suppress the Raoyang local bandits Kang Wendou, Guo Zhuangji, and others; the army advanced to campaign in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi, after the march through the passes, Guohan with gushan ejen Liu Zhiyuan, Zu Zerun, and others suppressed the Raoyang bandits Kang Wendou and Guo Zhuangji, then advanced into Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 時李自成走陝西，其黨猶分據太原、平陽諸府，國翰與固山額真葉臣謀曰：「自成新敗，賊無固志，當以大兵直搗太原。

translations.literal: At that time Li Zicheng had fled to Shaanxi, but his followers still held Taiyuan, Pingyang, and other prefectures in separate garrisons; Guohan and gushan ejen Ye Chen deliberated: "Zicheng has just been defeated; the bandits have no firm resolve; we should strike Taiyuan directly with a large force.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng had fled to Shaanxi, but his followers still held Taiyuan, Pingyang, and other prefectures. Guohan and gushan ejen Ye Chen agreed: "Zicheng is freshly beaten and his men have no stomach for a stand. We should drive straight at Taiyuan with the main force.

sentences.zh: 太原既下，分道略定諸郡縣，餘賊非降即就馘耳。」

translations.literal: Once Taiyuan is taken, send columns to pacify the prefectures and counties; the remaining bandits will either surrender or be beheaded."
translations.idiomatic: Once Taiyuan falls, we can send columns to sweep the prefectures and counties; the rest will either surrender or be cut down."

sentences.zh: 乃合兵進拔太原，分道略定諸郡縣。

translations.literal: They then united their forces, advanced, and took Taiyuan, and sent separate columns to pacify the prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: They united their forces, stormed Taiyuan, and sent columns to pacify the surrounding prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 師還，賚白金五百。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was rewarded with five hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was rewarded with five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 尋又從大將軍英親王阿濟格徵陝西，自成走湖廣，師從之，戰應山，進攻武昌，與固山額真金礪等奪舟數百。

translations.literal: Soon after he again followed Grand General Prince Ajige of Ying in campaigning in Shaanxi; Zicheng fled to Huguang and the army pursued; they fought at Yingshan, advanced to attack Wuchang, and with gushan ejen Jin Li and others seized several hundred boats.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Grand General Prince Ajige of Ying into Shaanxi. When Zicheng fled to Huguang the army pursued, fought at Yingshan, advanced on Wuchang, and with gushan ejen Jin Li seized several hundred boats.

sentences.zh: 二年，命偕固山額真巴顏率兵下四川，次西安，叛將賀珍自漢中來犯，國翰與駐防西安內大臣和洛輝分兵夾擊，大破之，進世職二等。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was ordered together with gushan ejen Bayan to lead troops into Sichuan; halting at Xi'an, the rebel general He Zhen came from Hanzhong to attack; Guohan and the grand minister Heluo stationed at Xi'an attacked from both sides and inflicted a great defeat; his hereditary rank was advanced to the second degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was ordered with gushan ejen Bayan into Sichuan. At Xi'an the rebel He Zhen marched down from Hanzhong; Guohan and Grand Minister Heluo, garrisoning Xi'an, caught him in a pincer and routed him. His hereditary rank rose to the second degree.

sentences.zh: 三年，大將軍肅親王豪格師至，令國翰與巴顏逐捕延安餘寇，寇保張果老崖，掘壕困之，乘夜攻克其寨，殲其渠，獲馬二百餘。

translations.literal: In the third year, when Grand General Prince Hoge of Su arrived, he ordered Guohan and Bayan to hunt down the remaining bandits of Yan'an; the bandits held Zhang Guolao Cliff; they dug trenches to hem them in, took the stockade by night assault, destroyed their leaders, and captured more than two hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when Grand General Prince Hoge arrived, he sent Guohan and Bayan after the Yan'an remnant bandits. The bandits held Zhang Guolao Cliff; trenches were dug to pin them in, and a night assault overran the stockade, killed the ringleaders, and seized more than two hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 遂從肅親王下四川，殲張獻忠，复率兵渡涪江，擊破獻忠將袁韜，進世職一等。

translations.literal: He then followed Prince Hoge into Sichuan, destroyed Zhang Xianzhong, again led troops across the Fu River, defeated Xianzhong's general Yuan Tao, and his hereditary rank was advanced to the first degree.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Hoge into Sichuan, destroyed Zhang Xianzhong, crossed the Fu River, defeated Xianzhong's general Yuan Tao, and was raised to first-degree hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，授定西將軍，同平西王吳三桂鎮漢中。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year, he was appointed Pacifier of the West general and together with Prince of Pacifying the West Wu Sangui garrisoned Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year he was named Pacifier of the West and, with Prince of Pacifying the West Wu Sangui, garrisoned Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 六年，明宗室硃森滏與其將趙榮貴以萬餘人犯階州，國翰督兵赴援，戰必先眾陷陣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Ming imperial clansman Zhu Senyu and his general Zhao Ronggui invaded Jiezhou with more than ten thousand men; Guohan directed troops to relieve the city and in battle always went ahead of the troops into the enemy line.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Ming clansman Zhu Senyu and his general Zhao Ronggui attacked Jiezhou with more than ten thousand men. Guohan marched to relieve the city and always led the charge himself.

sentences.zh: 諸將請曰：「將軍任討賊之重，柰何輕身犯鋒鏑？

translations.literal: The generals pleaded: "The general bears the heavy charge of suppressing bandits—why expose yourself lightly to blades and arrows?
translations.idiomatic: His officers pleaded: "You bear the weight of this campaign—why risk yourself in the front rank?

sentences.zh: 脫有不戒，憂及全軍。」

translations.literal: If through lack of caution something should happen, the whole army would be imperiled."
translations.idiomatic: One mischance could endanger the whole army."

sentences.zh: 國翰曰：「吾固知此。

translations.literal: Guohan said: "I know this well.
translations.idiomatic: Guohan replied: "I know that well enough.

sentences.zh: 然賊鋒頗銳，戰不利，勢將蔓延。

translations.literal: Yet the enemy's edge is quite sharp; if the battle goes badly, the situation will spread.
translations.idiomatic: But the enemy are sharp; if we fight poorly the trouble will spread.

sentences.zh: 吾故以力戰挫其鋒。

translations.literal: I therefore fight hard to blunt their edge.
translations.idiomatic: That is why I fight hard—to break their momentum.

sentences.zh: 明之失機，率由主兵者怯戰耗時，賊以坐大。

translations.literal: Ming's lost opportunities generally came from commanders who were timid in battle and wasted time, letting bandits grow strong by sitting idle.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming lost their chances because commanders were timid and slow, letting bandits grow strong while they waited.

sentences.zh: 覆轍可復蹈耶？」

translations.literal: Can we tread that overturned cart-track again?"
translations.idiomatic: Shall we repeat that mistake?"

sentences.zh: 遂戰，陣斬森滏、榮貴；

translations.literal: He then gave battle and killed Senyu and Ronggui in the line;
translations.idiomatic: He gave battle and killed Senyu and Ronggui on the field;

sentences.zh: 复擊破其將王永強，斬級數千，獲駝馬數百，复宜君、同官、蒲城、宜川、安塞、清澗等縣。

translations.literal: again defeated their general Wang Yongqiang, took several thousand heads, captured several hundred camels and horses, and recovered Yijun, Tongguan, Pucheng, Yichuan, Ansai, Qingjian, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: routed their general Wang Yongqiang, took several thousand heads and hundreds of camels and horses, and recovered Yijun, Tongguan, Pucheng, Yichuan, Ansai, Qingjian, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 上深嘉其勇略，諭以「自後但發縱指示，不必身先士卒」。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply praised his courage and strategy and instructed him: "Hereafter you need only give orders and direction; you need not lead the soldiers in person."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor greatly praised his courage and told him: "From now on give your orders from the rear; you need not lead every charge yourself."

sentences.zh: 叛將薑瓖據大同，其將劉登樓、張鳳翼、任一貴、謝汝德、萬鍊等分據附近諸郡縣，國翰遣兵會剿，殲賊甚眾，撫定河東；

translations.literal: The rebel general Jiang Xiang held Datong; his generals Liu Denglou, Zhang Fengyi, Ren Yigui, Xie Rude, Wan Lian, and others held nearby prefectures and counties in separate garrisons; Guohan sent troops in joint suppression, destroyed very many bandits, and pacified Hedong;
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Jiang Xiang held Datong while Liu Denglou, Zhang Fengyi, Ren Yigui, Xie Rude, Wan Lian, and others seized nearby prefectures and counties. Guohan sent columns against them, killed many bandits, and pacified Hedong;

sentences.zh: 進克府谷，擒斬所置經略高有才以下三百餘人，降其將郝自德等：進一等伯。

translations.literal: advanced and took Fugu, captured and executed more than three hundred men including the grand coordinator they had installed, Gao Youcai, and received the surrender of their general Hao Zide and others; he was advanced to first-rank bo.
translations.idiomatic: took Fugu, executed more than three hundred men including the puppet grand coordinator Gao Youcai, and received the surrender of Hao Zide and other generals. He was raised to first-rank earl.

sentences.zh: 九年，與三桂督兵復成都、嘉定，遣將徇重慶、敘州，皆下。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, with Sangui he directed troops to recover Chengdu and Jiading, sent generals to campaign in Chongqing and Xuzhou, and all were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he and Sangui recovered Chengdu and Jiading and sent generals against Chongqing and Xuzhou, all of which fell.

sentences.zh: 明將王復臣等糾倮儸萬餘人犯保寧，列象陣攻城，國翰自綿州赴援，督兵橫擊敵，陣斬复臣，殲其眾。

translations.literal: Ming general Wang Fuchen and others gathered more than ten thousand Luo and Yi to attack Baoning, forming an elephant array to assault the city; Guohan came from Mianzhou to relieve it, directed troops in a flank attack, killed Fuchen in the line, and annihilated his force.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming general Wang Fuchen mustered more than ten thousand Luo and Yi against Baoning and assaulted the walls with an elephant formation. Guohan marched from Mianzhou, struck the enemy in the flank, killed Fuchen on the field, and destroyed his army.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，進三等侯，賞紫貂冠服、H6金甲胄、櫜鞬、鞍馬。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, he was advanced to third-rank hou and rewarded with a sable hat and robe, gold armor, quiver and bow case, and saddle horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the victory report he was raised to third-rank marquis and rewarded with a sable hat and robe, gold armor, quiver and bow case, and a saddle horse.

sentences.zh: 十年，以四川平，命與三桂還鎮漢中。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because Sichuan was pacified, he was ordered with Sangui to return and garrison Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, with Sichuan pacified, he and Sangui were ordered back to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十四年，明將譚文等與自成餘黨劉二虎等為寇，陷重慶，使所置都督杜子香守之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Ming generals Tan Wen and others together with Zicheng's remnant follower Liu Erhu raided as bandits, took Chongqing, and installed their appointed regional commander Du Zixiang to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the Ming generals Tan Wen and Zicheng's remnant Liu Erhu raided, seized Chongqing, and left their appointed commander Du Zixiang to hold it.

sentences.zh: 十五年，國翰與三桂進討之，自西充下合州，子香迎戰，敗遁，復重慶，道桐梓，趨遵義。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Guohan and Sangui advanced to suppress them; from Xichong they descended on Hezhou; Zixiang met them in battle, was defeated and fled; they recovered Chongqing, passed through Tongzi, and pressed toward Zunyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Guohan and Sangui marched against them, descended from Xichong on Hezhou, routed Zixiang, retook Chongqing, passed Tongzi, and pressed on Zunyi.

sentences.zh: 明將李定國遣其將劉正國等據險拒戰，擊之潰，自水西走雲南，取遵義及所屬州縣；

translations.literal: Ming general Li Dingguo sent his generals Liu Zhengguo and others to hold difficult ground and resist; they were struck and routed, fled from Shuixi toward Yunnan, and Zunyi and its subordinate prefectures and counties were taken;
translations.idiomatic: Li Dingguo's generals Liu Zhengguo and others held the passes but were routed and fled from Shuixi toward Yunnan; Zunyi and its dependencies were taken;

sentences.zh: 復進克開州，並招降水西土司。

translations.literal: they advanced again and took Kaizhou, and also received the surrender of the Shuixi native chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Kaizhou was taken next, and the Shuixi chiefs submitted.

sentences.zh: 時大將軍羅託、經略洪承疇已取貴陽，國翰還駐遵義，策會師取雲南。

translations.literal: At that time Grand General Luotuo and supreme commander Hong Chengchou had already taken Guiyang; Guohan returned to garrison Zunyi and planned a joint advance to take Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Luotuo and supreme commander Hong Chengchou had already taken Guiyang; Guohan garrisoned Zunyi and planned a joint advance into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 七月，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He died in camp in the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 喪至京，命內大臣致奠，贈太子太保，諡敏壯，侯爵襲三次，循例改襲三等伯。

translations.literal: When the coffin reached the capital, a grand minister was ordered to offer sacrifice; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous title Minzhuang, the marquisate was to be inherited three times, and by regulation was thereafter to be inherited as third-rank bo.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin reached the capital a grand minister was sent to offer sacrifice. He was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the title Vigorous and Strong. The marquisate could pass three times, then by regulation revert to third-rank earl.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，加封號懋烈。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, the additional title Maolie was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong the additional title Meritorious and Ardent was granted.

sentences.zh: 海爾圖，國翰長子。

translations.literal: Hai'ertu was Guohan's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Hai'ertu was Guohan's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 初從國翰軍擊賀珍，破袁韜，皆在行，授兵部理事官、牛錄額真。

translations.literal: At first he followed Guohan's army in attacking He Zhen and defeating Yuan Tao, being present on all these campaigns; he was appointed an administrative officer of the Ministry of War and niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He first followed Guohan against He Zhen and Yuan Tao and was present throughout. He was made an administrative officer of the Ministry of War and niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 擢鑲藍旗漢軍梅勒額真，授戶部侍郎，坐事罷。

translations.literal: He was promoted to meirei ejen of the Han Bordered Blue Banner and appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue, but was dismissed on account of an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to meirei ejen of the Han Bordered Blue Banner and made vice minister of revenue, but was dismissed after an offense.

sentences.zh: 遷本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be gushan ejen of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to banner commander of his own banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，襲三等侯爵。

translations.literal: Early in the Kangxi reign, he inherited the third-rank marquisate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he inherited the third-rank marquisate.

sentences.zh: 定西將軍貝勒董鄂討叛將王輔臣，命海爾圖運砲赴軍前，並參贊軍務。

translations.literal: Pacifier of the West General Prince Dong'e campaigned against the rebel Wang Fuchen; Hai'ertu was ordered to transport cannon to the front and also to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Pacifier of the West Prince Dong'e campaigned against Wang Fuchen, Hai'ertu was ordered to bring cannon to the front and assist in planning.

sentences.zh: 尋以運砲遲誤，解參贊，留駐鳳翔。

translations.literal: Soon after, because the transport of cannon was delayed, he was relieved of his advisory post and left garrisoned at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon relieved for late delivery of the guns and left at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 從征雲、貴，二十年，卒於軍。

translations.literal: He joined the Yunnan-Guizhou campaign and in the twentieth year died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Yunnan-Guizhou campaign and died in camp in the twentieth year.

sentences.zh: 桑額，國翰第三子。

translations.literal: Sange was Guohan's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Sange was Guohan's third son.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，自參領擢寧夏總兵。

translations.literal: Early in the Kangxi reign, he was promoted from company commander to regional commander of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he rose from company commander to regional commander of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 遷雲南提督，未上官，吳三桂反，留駐荊州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be provincial military commander of Yunnan; before taking office, Wu Sangui rebelled, and he was kept garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yunnan as provincial commander, but before taking office Wu Sangui rebelled and he was held at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 改湖廣提督，移守武昌。

translations.literal: He was changed to provincial military commander of Huguang and moved to guard Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Huguang commander and posted to Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 從攻岳州，師進城陵磯，發砲沈敵艦，加右都督。

translations.literal: He joined the attack on Yuezhou; as the army advanced to Chenglingji, he fired cannon and sank enemy ships, and was given the additional rank of Right Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on Yuezhou. At Chenglingji his cannon sank enemy ships, and he was made Right Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 三桂兵自洞庭湖出，桑額擊之卻，逐至岳州城下，三桂兵引去，收萬容、石首、安鄉諸縣，加左都督。

translations.literal: Sangui's troops came out of Dongting Lake; Sange struck and drove them back, pursued to below the walls of Yuezhou, Sangui's troops withdrew, and Wanrong, Shishou, Anxiang, and other counties were recovered; he was given the additional rank of Left Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Sangui's men came out of Dongting Lake, Sange drove them back to Yuezhou and recovered Wanrong, Shishou, Anxiang, and other counties. He was made Left Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 詔趣進師，復以桑額為雲南提督，奏改湖廣提標兵為雲南提標，率之進克辰龍關，克辰州、沅州；

translations.literal: An edict urged rapid advance; he was again made provincial military commander of Yunnan, memorialized to convert the Huguang commander's standard troops into the Yunnan standard force, and led them forward to take Chenlong Pass and Chenzhou and Yuanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to advance quickly, he was again named Yunnan commander, converted the Huguang standard troops into the Yunnan standard force, and led them to take Chenlong Pass, Chenzhou, and Yuanzhou;

sentences.zh: 復進克鎮遠、平越，下貴陽，趨雞公背。

translations.literal: advanced again to take Zhenyuan and Pingyue, descended on Guiyang, and pressed toward Jigongbei.
translations.idiomatic: then took Zhenyuan and Pingyue, entered Guiyang, and pressed toward Jigongbei.

sentences.zh: 三桂兵焚鐵索橋走，桑額督土司沙起龍等築浮橋濟師。

translations.literal: Sangui's troops burned the iron-chain bridge and fled; Sange directed the native chief Sha Qilong and others to build a pontoon bridge to ferry the army across.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui's men burned the iron-chain bridge and fled. Sange had the native chief Sha Qilong build a pontoon bridge for the army.

sentences.zh: 旋從大將軍貝子彰泰攻下雲南省城，其將馬寶、胡國柱自四川還救，桑額與副都統託岱等破寶於楚雄，寶走降；

translations.literal: Soon after he followed Grand General Prince Zhangtai in taking the Yunnan provincial capital; Sangui's generals Ma Bao and Hu Guozhu returned from Sichuan to relieve it; Sange with vice commander-in-chief Todai and others defeated Bao at Chuxiong, and Bao fled and surrendered;
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Grand General Prince Zhangtai in taking the Yunnan capital. Ma Bao and Hu Guozhu marched back from Sichuan; Sange and vice commander Todai routed Bao at Chuxiong, and Bao fled and surrendered;

sentences.zh: 又與都統希福困國柱於永昌，國柱自經死。

translations.literal: again with commander Xifu he hemmed in Guozhu at Yongchang, and Guozhu hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: then with commander Xifu besieged Guozhu at Yongchang until Guozhu hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 雲南平。

translations.literal: Yunnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 初，桑額標兵中道有潰散者，上遣左都御史哲勒肯按治，疏言標兵家口在武昌，無資養贍，逃回者千餘人。

translations.literal: Earlier, some of Sange's standard troops had scattered on the march; the emperor sent Left Censor-in-Chief Zheleken to investigate; he memorialized that the standard troops' families were at Wuchang without means of support, and more than a thousand had fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier some of Sange's standard troops had broken on the march. The emperor sent Left Censor-in-Chief Zheleken to investigate; he reported that their families at Wuchang lacked support and more than a thousand men had deserted home.

sentences.zh: 上切責桑額不恤士卒，部議奪職，命留任，敘功復職。

translations.literal: The emperor sharply rebuked Sange for not caring for the soldiers; the ministry proposed dismissal from office, but he was ordered to remain in post, and on reckoning merit his office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sharply rebuked Sange for neglecting his men. The ministry proposed dismissal, but he was kept in post and later restored on merit.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-fifth year.

sentences.zh: 卓布泰，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Zhuobutai was of the Guwalgiya clan, a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuobutai was of the Guwalgiya clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父衛齊，費英東第九弟。

translations.literal: His father Weiqi was the ninth younger brother of Fei Yingdong.
translations.idiomatic: His father Weiqi was the ninth younger brother of Fei Yingdong.

sentences.zh: 事太祖，從特爾晉等率兵伐虎爾哈，得五百戶以歸，授世職備禦。

translations.literal: Serving the Taizu, he followed Terjin and others in leading troops against the Hurha, brought back five hundred households, and was granted a hereditary defensive office.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taizu he joined Terjin against the Hurha, brought back five hundred households, and received a hereditary defensive rank.

sentences.zh: 天聰初，從太宗伐明，略遵化，進世職游擊。

translations.literal: Early in Tiancong, he followed the Taizong in campaigning against Ming, raided Zunhua, and his hereditary rank was advanced to guerrilla.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tiancong he joined the Taizong against the Ming, raided Zunhua, and was raised to guerrilla rank.

sentences.zh: 上統大軍出征，每令衛齊留守盛京，任八門提督。

translations.literal: When the emperor led the great army on campaign, he always left Weiqi to remain and guard Shengjing, holding the post of commander of the Eight Gates.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor marched out, Weiqi was left to guard Mukden as commander of the Eight Gates.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 順治間，追諡端勤。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, he was posthumously given the title Duankin.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shunzhi he was posthumously titled Upright and Diligent.

sentences.zh: 子鰲拜，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Oboi has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Oboi has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 卓布泰，其次子也。

translations.literal: Zhuobutai was his second son.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuobutai was his second son.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Serving the Taizong, he was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taizong he was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德四年，從承政薩穆什喀、索海伐瑚爾哈部，鐸陳、阿薩津二城以兵四百逆戰，卓布泰與牛錄額真薩弼圖率甲士九十人擊敗之，斬級五十。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongde, he followed chief minister Samushka and Suohai in campaigning against the Hurha tribes; the two cities Duochen and Asajin met them with four hundred troops; Zhuobutai with niru ejen Sabitu led ninety armored soldiers to defeat them and took fifty heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chongde he followed Samushka and Suohai against the Hurha. The cities Duochen and Asajin met them with four hundred men; Zhuobutai and niru ejen Sabitu with ninety armored soldiers routed them and took fifty heads.

sentences.zh: 敵復與索倫部長博穆博果爾合兵以拒，卓布泰率先邀擊，俘六十餘人。

translations.literal: The enemy again combined with the Solon chief Bombogor to resist; Zhuobutai took the lead in intercepting them and captured more than sixty men.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy joined the Solon chief Bombogor; Zhuobutai intercepted them first and took more than sixty prisoners.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was promoted to jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍錦州，明總督洪承疇屯山口拒守。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he joined the campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou; Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou encamped at the mountain pass to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the siege of Jinzhou while Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou held the mountain pass.

sentences.zh: 卓布泰與梅勒額真翁阿岱迎戰，明兵敗走，大軍合擊，復與翁阿岱力戰破敵。

translations.literal: Zhuobutai with meirei ejen Wengadai met them in battle; the Ming troops were defeated and fled; the main army joined the attack, and again with Wengadai he fought hard and broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuobutai and meirei ejen Wengadai gave battle, routed the Ming, and with the main army struck again to break them.

sentences.zh: 師還，敵躡我後，翁阿岱中創僕，卓布泰還殲敵，掖翁阿岱乘馬歸。

translations.literal: On the army's return the enemy followed our rear; Wengadai was wounded and fell; Zhuobutai turned back, destroyed the enemy, and helped Wengadai mount a horse and return.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march the enemy pursued. Wengadai was wounded and fell; Zhuobutai turned back, destroyed the pursuers, and helped Wengadai onto a horse.

sentences.zh: 七年，從伐明，徇山東至青州，屢敗明兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he joined the campaign against Ming, campaigned through Shandong to Qingzhou, and repeatedly defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he campaigned through Shandong to Qingzhou and repeatedly defeated Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 明將張登科、和應薦等合八鎮兵來拒，卓布泰率兵奮擊，大破之，复乘夜襲破餘兵。

translations.literal: Ming generals Zhang Dengke, He Yingjian, and others combined the troops of eight garrisons to resist; Zhuobutai led troops in fierce attack and inflicted a great defeat; he again made a night assault and broke the remaining troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dengke, He Yingjian, and others mustered eight garrison armies against him; Zhuobutai routed them in a hard fight and that night overran the remnant.

sentences.zh: 八年，師還，賚白金，兼任兵部理事官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when the army returned, he was rewarded with white silver and concurrently appointed an administrative officer of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the army's return, he was rewarded with silver and made an administrative officer of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，偕甲喇額真沙爾瑚達略黑龍江，克圖瑚勒禪城，俘二百餘人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, together with jalan ejen Sha'erhu he raided the Amur region, took the city of Tuhulen, and captured more than two hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he raided the Amur with jalan ejen Sha'erhu, took Tuhulen, and captured more than two hundred men.

sentences.zh: 是冬，從大將軍豫親王多鐸西討李自成，次潼關，與固山額真恩格圖等迭戰破敵。

translations.literal: That winter, he followed Grand General Prince Dorgon of Yu in the western campaign against Li Zicheng, halted at Tong Pass, and with gushan ejen Engetu and others fought in succession and broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he followed Grand General Prince Dorgon west against Li Zicheng, halted at Tong Pass, and with gushan ejen Engetu broke the enemy in successive fights.

sentences.zh: 二年，進克西安，自成走湖廣，與巴牙喇纛章京敦拜、阿爾津等追擊，殲敵騎三百。

translations.literal: In the second year, he advanced and took Xi'an; Zicheng fled to Huguang; with Baya-i banner janggin Dunbai, Arjin, and others he pursued and destroyed three hundred enemy horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he took Xi'an. When Zicheng fled to Huguang, Zhuobutai with vanguard commander Dunbai and Arjin pursued and destroyed three hundred horsemen.

sentences.zh: 移師下江南，從貝勒博洛徇浙江，敗敵於杭州、於海寧、於平湖，得戰艦百餘。

translations.literal: The army moved into Jiangnan; he followed Prince Bolo in campaigning in Zhejiang, defeated the enemy at Hangzhou, at Haining, and at Pinghu, and obtained more than a hundred war junks.
translations.idiomatic: The army moved into Jiangnan. Following Prince Bolo through Zhejiang, he defeated the enemy at Hangzhou, Haining, and Pinghu and seized more than a hundred war junks.

sentences.zh: 三年，復從徇福建，署梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the third year, he again followed the campaign in Fujian and served as acting meirei ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he campaigned again in Fujian as acting meirei ejen.

sentences.zh: 次延平，明唐王聿鍵走汀州，師從之，卓布泰別將兵攻克福州。

translations.literal: Halting at Yanping, the Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou and the army pursued; Zhuobutai with a separate force took Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At Yanping the Ming Prince of Tang fled to Tingzhou; while the main force pursued, Zhuobutai with a detached column took Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 敘功並考滿，進世職三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In reckoning merit and on completing his term evaluation, his hereditary rank was advanced to third-rank adaha ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: For merit and a satisfactory term review he was raised to third-rank adaha ha'an.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗下湖廣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng into Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 六年，复署梅勒額真，與固山額真佟圖賴等自湘潭進克衡州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he again served as acting meirei ejen and with gushan ejen Tuntu and others advanced from Xiangtan and took Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again acted as meirei ejen and with gushan ejen Tuntu advanced from Xiangtan to take Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 明將胡一清以步騎萬餘踞城南山岡，列七營，與佟圖賴合攻之，潰走；

translations.literal: The Ming general Hu Yiqing with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry held the southern hills outside the city, arrayed seven camps, and together with Tuntu attacked them; they broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ming general Hu Yiqing held the southern hills outside the city with more than ten thousand foot and horse, drew up seven camps, and was routed when he and Tuntu attacked together.

sentences.zh: 復進克道州、靖州。

translations.literal: They then advanced and took Daozhou and Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: They then advanced and captured Daozhou and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，優賚，授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was richly rewarded and appointed vice minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was richly rewarded and made vice minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 累擢內大臣、鑲黃旗滿洲固山額真，進世職二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to grand minister of the interior and gushan ejen of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and his hereditary rank was advanced to second-rank ashan i ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to grand minister of the interior and gushan ejen of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and his hereditary rank was raised to second-rank ashan i ha'an.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授征南將軍，率師至廣西會湖南、四川兩軍規取雲、貴。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed general who pacifies the south, led the army to Guangxi, joined the Hunan and Sichuan armies, and planned the recovery of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made general who pacifies the south, marched to Guangxi, joined the Hunan and Sichuan forces, and planned the conquest of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月，師次獨山，與信郡王多尼及吳三桂會約師期，語詳洪承疇傳。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year the army halted at Dushan; he met with Prince Duo Ni of Xin and Wu Sangui to fix the date of the advance; the details are given in the biography of Hong Chengchou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year the army halted at Dushan, where he met Prince Duo Ni of Xin and Wu Sangui to set the date of advance; the account is given in Hong Chengchou's biography.

sentences.zh: 卓布泰率兵自都勻進次盤江，明兵聞師至，沉舟，潛匿山谷中。

translations.literal: Zhuobutai led troops from Duyun and halted at the Pan River; when the Ming troops heard the army had arrived, they sank their boats and hid in the mountain valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuobutai marched from Duyun to the Pan River. Hearing of his approach, the Ming forces sank their boats and concealed themselves in the valleys.

sentences.zh: 卓布泰用土司岑繼魯言，渡下流取所沉舟，中夜濟師。

translations.literal: Zhuobutai followed the advice of the native chieftain Cen Jilu, crossed downstream to recover the sunken boats, and ferried the army across in the middle of the night.
translations.idiomatic: At the suggestion of native chieftain Cen Jilu, Zhuobutai crossed downstream, recovered the sunken boats, and moved the army across the river in the dead of night.

sentences.zh: 明將李承爵以萬餘人屯涼水井，師進擊破之，攻雙河口山寨。

translations.literal: The Ming general Li Chengjue with more than ten thousand men encamped at Liangshui Well; the army advanced, defeated him, and attacked the stockade at Shuanghekou.
translations.idiomatic: Ming general Li Chengjue encamped at Liangshui Well with more than ten thousand men. The army advanced, routed him, and attacked the stockade at Shuanghekou.

sentences.zh: 明將李定國以像陣拒戰，擊潰之。

translations.literal: The Ming general Li Dingguo resisted with an elephant formation; they attacked and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ming general Li Dingguo fought with an elephant formation and was routed.

sentences.zh: 定國悉眾為三十營，列柵固守，卓布泰分軍為三隊，張左右翼以進，再戰皆勝，追奔四十餘裡，獲其像、馬。

translations.literal: Dingguo gathered all his forces into thirty camps, set palisades and held firm; Zhuobutai divided the army into three columns, extended the left and right wings to advance, won both engagements, pursued the fugitives for more than forty li, and captured their elephants and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo massed his entire force in thirty fortified camps. Zhuobutai split his army into three columns, advanced with both wings extended, won two battles in succession, pursued the enemy more than forty li, and seized their elephants and horses.

sentences.zh: 聞明兵尚堅守鐵索橋，乃自普安間道進羅平，會信郡王等軍攻克雲南省城，明桂王奔永昌。

translations.literal: Hearing that Ming troops still held the iron-chain bridge firmly, he took a byway from Pu'an toward Luoping, joined the armies of Prince Duo Ni and the others, and took the provincial capital of Yunnan; the Ming Prince of Gui fled to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Ming forces still held the iron-chain bridge, he took a detour from Pu'an toward Luoping, joined Prince Duo Ni's army, and captured the Yunnan provincial capital; the Ming Prince of Gui fled to Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月，從貝勒尚善等進軍鎮南，破白文選於玉龍關，渡瀾滄江，取永昌，明桂王奔騰越，師復進，渡潞江。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixteenth year he followed Prince Shangshan and others in advancing on Zhennan, defeated Bai Wenxuan at Yulong Pass, crossed the Lancang River, took Yongchang, the Ming Prince of Gui fled to Tengyue, and the army advanced again and crossed the Lu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixteenth year he marched on Zhennan with Prince Shangshan, routed Bai Wenxuan at Yulong Pass, crossed the Lancang River, and took Yongchang. The Ming Prince of Gui fled to Tengyue; the army pressed on and crossed the Lu River.

sentences.zh: 定國以六千人伏磨盤山，卓布泰分兵為八隊，以火器發其伏，掩擊，斬殺過半，遂克騰越。

translations.literal: Dingguo with six thousand men lay in ambush at Mopan Mountain; Zhuobutai divided his troops into eight companies, used firearms to flush out the ambush, struck from concealment, killed more than half, and then took Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo ambushed six thousand men on Mopan Mountain. Zhuobutai divided his force into eight companies, flushed the ambush with firearms, struck from cover, killed more than half the enemy, and captured Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 明桂王奔緬甸，卓布泰乘勝追擊，越南甸至猛卯而還。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Gui fled to Burma; Zhuobutai pursued in victory through southern Dian as far as Mengmao and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Gui fled into Burma. Zhuobutai pursued in triumph through southern Dian to Mengmao and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，賚蟒服、鞍馬。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, he was granted python robes and saddled horses.
translations.idiomatic: On report of the victory he was granted python robes and saddled horses.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年二月，師還，上命內大臣迎勞。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Kangxi the army returned; the emperor ordered a grand minister to go out and welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Kangxi 1 the army returned, and the emperor sent a grand minister to welcome it.

sentences.zh: 尋追論在軍勘將士功罪不實，與議政王貝勒爭辨語怨望，論絞籍沒，上命寬之，奪世職，罷都統。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was called to account for having assessed the merits and faults of officers and soldiers in the field untruthfully; in disputing with the regent prince he spoke with resentment; the sentence was strangulation and confiscation of property; the emperor ordered leniency, stripped his hereditary rank, and dismissed him from the post of dutong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon charged with falsifying battlefield merit and fault among officers and soldiers, and in arguing with the regent prince spoke resentfully. Sentenced to strangulation and confiscation, he was spared by the emperor but stripped of his hereditary rank and removed as dutong.

sentences.zh: 三年，复世職。

translations.literal: In the third year his hereditary rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year his hereditary rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 八年，復以弟鰲拜得罪，奪世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because his younger brother Oboi had fallen from favor, his hereditary rank was again taken away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year his hereditary rank was again revoked when his younger brother Oboi fell from favor.

sentences.zh: 十六年，再复世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year his hereditary rank was restored once more.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year his hereditary rank was restored again.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，諡武襄。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died; his posthumous title was Wuxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventeenth year and was posthumously titled Wuxiang.

sentences.zh: 巴哈，卓布泰弟。

translations.literal: Baha was Zhuobutai's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Baha was Zhuobutai's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，以一等侍衛授議政大臣。

translations.literal: Serving the Taizong, he was appointed a first-rank bodyguard and made a deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taizong he served as a first-rank bodyguard and was made a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 順治初，入關，從肅親王豪格徵張獻忠有功，世職累進一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he entered the pass, followed Prince Haoge of Su in campaigning against Zhang Xianzhong with merit, and his hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to first-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi he entered the pass and followed Prince Haoge of Su against Zhang Xianzhong with distinction; his hereditary rank rose to first-rank jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 睿親王討姜瓖，巴哈請從征，王勿許，拂衣起，坐論死，命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: When the Prince Regent campaigned against Jiang Xiang, Baha asked to join the expedition; the prince would not permit it; he rose and left in anger; he was sentenced to death by sitting, but was ordered to redeem himself by paying a fine.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince Regent marched against Jiang Xiang, Baha asked to join the campaign. Refused, he rose angrily and left. Condemned to death by sitting, he was allowed to redeem himself with a fine.

sentences.zh: 睿親王攝政，巴哈兄弟獨不附。

translations.literal: When the Prince Regent held regency, the Baha brothers alone would not attach themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Prince Regent's regency, the Baha brothers alone refused to align with him.

sentences.zh: 肅親王卒於獄，子富綬尚幼，尚書宗室鞏阿岱議殺之，巴哈及內大臣哈什屯持不可，乃止。
