translations.literal: When Prince Su died in prison his son Fushou was still young; Minister of the Imperial Clan Gongadai proposed killing him; Baha and Grand Minister Hashitun held that this must not be done, and the plan was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Su died in prison his son Fushou was still a child. Minister Gongadai proposed killing him, but Baha and Grand Minister Hashitun objected and the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 鞏阿岱因與弟錫翰及內大臣西訥布庫等欲構陷以罪，聞上嘉其勤勞，議乃寢。

translations.literal: Because Gongadai together with his younger brother Xihan and Grand Minister Sinabuku and others wished to frame him with a charge, but heard that the emperor praised his diligence, the plot was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Gongadai, his brother Xihan, Grand Minister Sinabuku, and others tried to frame him, but when they learned the emperor praised his diligence the plot was dropped.

sentences.zh: 世祖親政，使證鞏阿岱等罪狀，皆坐誅。

translations.literal: When the Shizu personally took power, he was made to testify to the crimes of Gongadai and the others, and all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Shizu took personal rule, Baha testified against Gongadai and the others, and all were put to death.

sentences.zh: 復命為議政大臣，世職累進一等阿思哈尼哈番，加少傅兼太子太傅，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: He was again appointed a deliberative minister; his hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to first-rank ashan i ha'an; he was made junior tutor and grand tutor of the heir apparent and appointed chief grand minister of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made a deliberative minister, raised to first-rank ashan i ha'an, appointed junior tutor and grand tutor of the heir apparent, and made chief grand minister of the guard.

sentences.zh: 鰲拜得罪，坐罷官奪世職。

translations.literal: When Oboi fell from favor, he was dismissed from office and stripped of his hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: When Oboi fell, he was dismissed and stripped of his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 蘇勒達，巴哈子。

translations.literal: Suleda was Baha's son.
translations.idiomatic: Suleda was Baha's son.

sentences.zh: 事聖祖，授侍衛。

translations.literal: Serving the Shengzu, he was appointed a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Shengzu he was appointed a bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷鑲黃旗蒙古都統、領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Mongol dutong of the Bordered Yellow Banner and chief grand minister of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Mongol dutong of the Bordered Yellow Banner and chief grand minister of the guard.

sentences.zh: 上親征噶爾丹，從行，贊議進擊，复扈上巡行塞北，賜內廝馬。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan, he accompanied the expedition, urged an advance attack, again escorted the emperor on a tour of the northern frontier, and was granted an imperial stable horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor's personal campaign against Galdan he accompanied the army, urged an offensive, later escorted the emperor on a northern frontier tour, and received an imperial stable horse.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恪僖。

translations.literal: He died; his posthumous title was Kexi.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously titled Kexi.

sentences.zh: 卓羅，滿洲正白旗人，巴篤理子也。

translations.literal: Zhuoluo was a man of the Manchu Plain White Banner and a son of Baduli.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoluo was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and a son of Baduli.

sentences.zh: 卓羅襲三等副將，兼任牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Zhuoluo inherited the rank of third-rank deputy general and concurrently served as niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoluo inherited third-rank deputy general and concurrently served as niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，從伐明，薄明都，明太監楊永盛出戰，卓羅以三百人擊敗之，遂進略山東。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he followed the campaign against Ming, approached the Ming capital, the Ming eunuch Yang Yongsheng came out to fight, and Zhuoluo with three hundred men defeated him and then advanced to overrun Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he joined the campaign against the Ming and approached the capital. When the Ming eunuch Yang Yongsheng came out to fight, Zhuoluo routed him with three hundred men and then overran Shandong.

sentences.zh: 四年，圍錦州，入其郛，獲守備一。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he besieged Jinzhou, entered the outer wall, and captured one defending officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he besieged Jinzhou, entered the outer rampart, and captured a defending officer.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，擊敗明總督洪承疇。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again besieged Jinzhou and defeated Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again invested Jinzhou and defeated Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou.

sentences.zh: 八年，授刑部參政。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed vice director of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed vice director of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，破李自成，進世職一等梅勒章京，擢正白旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the pass, defeated Li Zicheng, his hereditary rank was advanced to first-rank meirei janggin, and he was promoted to meirei ejen of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi he entered the pass, defeated Li Zicheng, was raised to first-rank meirei janggin, and promoted to meirei ejen of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 三年，從大將軍順承郡王勒克德渾下湖廣，敗自成黨一隻虎於荊州。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the great general Prince Jirhalang of Shuncheng into Huguang and defeated Li Zicheng's follower Yizhihu at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed the great general Prince Jirhalang of Shuncheng into Huguang and routed Li Zicheng's follower Yizhihu at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，賚黃金十兩、白金三百兩。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was granted ten taels of gold and three hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was granted ten taels of gold and three hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 是時明桂王由榔駐武岡，其將王進才等分守長沙、衡州、寶慶。

translations.literal: At that time the Ming Prince of Gui Zhu Youlang was stationed at Wugang, and his generals Wang Jincai and others separately held Changsha, Hengzhou, and Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Ming Prince of Gui Zhu Youlang was at Wugang, while his generals Wang Jincai and others held Changsha, Hengzhou, and Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 大將軍恭順王孔有德等收湖南諸郡縣，命卓羅及梅勒額真藍拜率師益有德。

translations.literal: The great general Prince Gongshun Kong Youde and others recovered the prefectures and counties of Hunan and ordered Zhuoluo and meirei ejen Lanbai to lead troops to reinforce Youde.
translations.idiomatic: Great general Prince Gongshun Kong Youde recovered Hunan's prefectures and counties and ordered Zhuoluo and meirei ejen Lanbai to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 四年，自岳州趨長沙，進才棄城走，卓羅等追擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he marched from Yuezhou toward Changsha; Jincai abandoned the city and fled, and Zhuoluo and the others pursued and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he marched from Yuezhou on Changsha. Jincai abandoned the city and fled; Zhuoluo pursued and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 遂與智順王尚可喜共擊敗明總兵徐松節，率舟師還長沙。

translations.literal: He then joined Prince Zhishun Shang Kexi in defeating Ming regional commander Xu Songjie and returned to Changsha by river.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Prince Zhishun Shang Kexi in defeating Ming regional commander Xu Songjie and returned to Changsha by boat.

sentences.zh: 遣甲喇額真張國柱、札蘇藍等以偏師擊敗明總兵楊國棟於天心湖。

translations.literal: He sent jalan ejen Zhang Guozhu, Jasulan, and others with a detached force to defeat Ming regional commander Yang Guodong at Tianxin Lake.
translations.idiomatic: He sent jalan ejen Zhang Guozhu, Jasulan, and others with a detached column to rout Ming regional commander Yang Guodong at Tianxin Lake.

sentences.zh: 卓羅會有德下祁陽，道熊羆嶺，克其城。

translations.literal: Zhuoluo joined Youde in descending on Qiyang, passed Xiongpi Ridge, and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoluo joined Youde at Qiyang, crossed Xiongpi Ridge, and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 進攻武岡，擊敗明將劉承胤於夕陽橋，承胤降。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Wugang, he defeated the Ming general Liu Chengyin at Xiyang Bridge; Chengyin surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Wugang he defeated Ming general Liu Chengyin at Xiyang Bridge, and Chengyin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 明桂王走桂林，遂取武岡。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Gui fled to Guilin, and Wugang was taken.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Gui fled to Guilin, and Wugang fell.

sentences.zh: 五年，師還，上賚如自荊州還時。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the army returned, the emperor rewarded him as when he had returned from Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the army's return, the emperor rewarded him as on his return from Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 累擢吏部尚書，兼鑲白旗滿洲固山額真，進一等精奇尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to minister of the Board of Personnel, concurrently gushan ejen of the Manchu Plain White Banner, and advanced to first-rank jingkini ha'an with tosoro ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to minister of the Board of Personnel and gushan ejen of the Manchu Plain White Banner, and was raised to first-rank jingkini ha'an with tosoro ha'an.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月，授靖南將軍，下廣東。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the ninth year he was appointed general who pacifies the south and descended on Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year he was made general who pacifies the south and marched into Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 旋以廣東垂定，罷。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because Guangdong was nearly settled, the appointment was revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, with Guangdong nearly pacified, the appointment was revoked.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，命與固山額真阿爾津帥師屯荊州，時張獻忠將孫可望、李定國、白文選等降於明，屯辰州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year he was ordered with gushan ejen A'erjin to command troops encamped at Jingzhou; at that time Zhang Xianzhong's generals Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and Bai Wenxuan had surrendered to the Ming and were encamped at Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year he and gushan ejen A'erjin were ordered to encamp at Jingzhou. Zhang Xianzhong's generals Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and Bai Wenxuan had by then surrendered to the Ming and held Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十三年八月，卓羅與阿爾津道澧州、常德，下辰州，可望焚舟夜遁，卓羅與梅勒額真泰什哈、巴牙喇纛章京費雅思哈等率兵渡江攻之，遂克辰州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year Zhuoluo and A'erjin passed Lizhou and Changde, descended on Chenzhou, Kewang burned his boats and fled by night, and Zhuoluo with meirei ejen Taishiha, bayara da janggin Feiyasihha, and others led troops across the river to attack and then took Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year Zhuoluo and A'erjin passed through Lizhou and Changde and marched on Chenzhou. Kewang burned his boats and fled by night; Zhuoluo crossed the river with meirei ejen Taishiha, bayara da janggin Feiyasihha, and others and captured Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，可望詣長沙降，定國、文選等從明桂王入雲南。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Kewang went to Changsha to surrender; Dingguo, Wenxuan, and the others followed the Ming Prince of Gui into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Kewang surrendered at Changsha; Dingguo, Wenxuan, and the others entered Yunnan with the Ming Prince of Gui.

sentences.zh: 十五年，規取雲南，吳三桂自四川，征南將軍卓布泰自廣西，卓羅從信郡王多尼自湖南，三道並進。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, planning to take Yunnan, Wu Sangui came from Sichuan, General Zhuobutai from Guangxi, and Zhuoluo followed Prince Duo Ni from Hunan; the three routes advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, as Yunnan was targeted, Wu Sangui came from Sichuan, General Zhuobutai from Guangxi, and Zhuoluo followed Prince Duo Ni from Hunan; all three columns advanced together.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，合攻雲南，克之，屢敗文選、定國兵，收永昌、騰越，追擊至南甸。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year they jointly attacked Yunnan and took it, repeatedly defeated Wenxuan's and Dingguo's troops, recovered Yongchang and Tengyue, and pursued as far as Nandian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year they jointly attacked and captured Yunnan, repeatedly routed Wenxuan and Dingguo, recovered Yongchang and Tengyue, and pursued to Nandian.

sentences.zh: 命卓羅守雲南，賚蟒服、鞍馬。

translations.literal: Zhuoluo was ordered to guard Yunnan and was granted python robes and saddled horses.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoluo was ordered to hold Yunnan and was granted python robes and saddled horses.

sentences.zh: 明桂王奔緬甸，定國屯孟艮，以印劄招元江土司那嵩。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Gui fled to Burma; Dingguo encamped at Menggen and used sealed documents to summon the Yuanjiang native chieftain Na Song.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Gui fled into Burma. Dingguo held Menggen and summoned the Yuanjiang chieftain Na Song with sealed documents.

sentences.zh: 十月，卓羅與噶布什賢噶喇昂邦白爾赫圖等共擊之，克其城，那嵩自焚死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Zhuoluo with gabushiyan gala angbang Ba'erhetu and others jointly attacked, took the city, and Na Song burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhuoluo, gabushiyan gala angbang Ba'erhetu, and others attacked jointly, captured the city, and Na Song burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 十八年，定西將軍愛星阿與三桂帥師入緬甸，卓羅仍守雲南。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year General Aixing'a and Sangui led the army into Burma, while Zhuoluo continued to guard Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year General Aixing'a and Sangui marched into Burma while Zhuoluo remained to guard Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 緬甸執明桂王詣軍，雲南平。

translations.literal: Burma delivered the Ming Prince of Gui to the army, and Yunnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Burma handed over the Ming Prince of Gui to the army, and Yunnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，召卓羅振旅還京，進二等伯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi Zhuoluo was recalled with the army to the capital and was advanced to second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 Zhuoluo was recalled to the capital with the army and was raised to second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒，諡忠襄。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died; his posthumous title was Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year and was posthumously titled Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，定封號曰昭毅。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign the fixed title of nobility was declared Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianlong reign his noble title was fixed as Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 永慶，卓羅四世孫。

translations.literal: Yongqing was Zhuoluo's fourth-generation descendant.
translations.idiomatic: Yongqing was Zhuoluo's fourth-generation descendant.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，以護軍參領降襲三等伯。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign he inherited the third-rank baron as a guard lieutenant colonel with a reduced inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianlong reign he inherited the third-rank baron with reduced rank as a guard lieutenant colonel.

sentences.zh: 旋擢副都統。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to vice dutong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to vice dutong.

sentences.zh: 從征準噶爾有功，加雲騎尉，仍進二等伯。

translations.literal: Campaigning against the Dzungars with merit, he was granted yunqi wei and again advanced to second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: For merit on campaign against the Dzungars he received yunqi wei and was again raised to second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 出為烏魯木齊副都統。

translations.literal: He was sent out as vice dutong of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as vice dutong of Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 遷江寧將軍，移綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to general of Jiangning and then to general of Suiyuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: He became general of Jiangning and then general of Suiyuancheng.

sentences.zh: 召還，擢禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Recalled to court, he was promoted to minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was promoted to minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 罷，授內大臣。

translations.literal: Dismissed, he was appointed a grand minister of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: After dismissal he was appointed grand minister of the interior.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年七月，卒，諡敬僖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year of Jiaqing he died; his posthumous title was Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh month of Jiaqing 10 and was posthumously titled Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 旋以在綏遠城嘗受賕，事露，奪諡。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because while at Suiyuancheng he had once accepted a bribe and the matter came to light, his posthumous title was revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward his posthumous title was revoked when it came to light that he had accepted a bribe at Suiyuancheng.

sentences.zh: 愛星阿，滿洲正黃旗人，揚古利孫也。

translations.literal: Aixing'a was a man of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and a grandson of Yangguli.
translations.idiomatic: Aixing'a was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a grandson of Yangguli.

sentences.zh: 父塔瞻，襲封一等公，卒，愛星阿襲封。

translations.literal: His father Tazan inherited the rank of first-rank duke; when he died, Aixing'a inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tazan held first-rank duke; on his death Aixing'a inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 世祖念揚古利舊勞，命加給三等阿達哈哈番俸。

translations.literal: The Shizu, mindful of Yangguli's old service, ordered an additional stipend of third-rank adaha ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Yangguli's old service, the Shizu granted an additional third-rank adaha ha'an stipend.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi he was appointed chief grand minister of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 he was appointed chief grand minister of the guard.

sentences.zh: 明桂王由榔與其將沐天波等奔緬甸，李定國居孟艮，白文選屯木邦，皆在雲南邊外。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Gui Zhu Youlang with his generals Mu Tianbo and others fled to Burma; Li Dingguo was at Menggen, Bai Wenxuan at Mubang, all beyond Yunnan's borders.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Gui Zhu Youlang fled to Burma with generals such as Mu Tianbo; Li Dingguo held Menggen and Bai Wenxuan Mubang, both beyond Yunnan's frontier.

sentences.zh: 上命吳三桂鎮雲南，三桂疏請發兵入緬甸取由榔。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Wu Sangui to garrison Yunnan; Sangui memorialized asking to send troops into Burma to seize Youlang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Wu Sangui to garrison Yunnan. Sangui asked permission to march into Burma and seize Youlang.

sentences.zh: 十七年，授愛星阿定西將軍，與都統卓羅、果爾欽、遜塔，護軍統領畢力克圖、費雅思哈，前鋒統領白爾赫圖率禁旅會三桂南征。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Aixing'a was appointed general who pacifies the west; with dutong Zhuoluo, Guo'erqin, and Xunta, guard commander Biliketu, Feiyasihha, and vanguard commander Ba'erhetu he led the imperial guard to join Sangui on the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Aixing'a was made general who pacifies the west. With dutong Zhuoluo, Guo'erqin, and Xunta, guard commander Biliketu, Feiyasihha, and vanguard commander Ba'erhetu he led the imperial guard to join Sangui's southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 十八年，師行，聞世祖大行，三桂猶豫不進。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, as the army marched, word came that the Shizu had died; Sangui hesitated and would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, as the army set out, news arrived of the Shizu's death; Sangui hesitated to advance.

sentences.zh: 愛星阿曰：「君命不可棄。」

translations.literal: Aixing'a said: "The ruler's command must not be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: Aixing'a said, "The ruler's command must not be abandoned."

sentences.zh: 督兵先行，三日，三桂乃發。

translations.literal: He urged the troops forward; three days later Sangui set out.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed the troops forward; three days later Sangui followed.

sentences.zh: 九月，師次大理，休兵秣馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army halted at Dali and rested the troops and fed the horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army halted at Dali to rest the men and feed the horses.

sentences.zh: 踰月，出騰越，道南甸、隴川、猛卯。

translations.literal: After a month they set out from Tengyue, passing Nandian, Longchuan, and Mengmao.
translations.idiomatic: A month later they marched from Tengyue by way of Nandian, Longchuan, and Mengmao.

sentences.zh: 十一月，至木邦，獲文選將馮國恩，訊知文選屯錫箔江濱，定國與不協，走景線。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month they reached Mubang, captured Wenxuan's general Feng Guoen, and on interrogation learned that Wenxuan was encamped on the bank of the Xibo River, that Dingguo was at odds with him, and that he had gone to Jingxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they reached Mubang and captured Wenxuan's general Feng Guoen. From him they learned that Wenxuan held the Xibo River, that he and Dingguo were at odds, and that Dingguo had gone to Jingxian.

sentences.zh: 愛星阿令白爾赫圖等簡精銳，疾馳三百餘里至江濱，文選已毀橋走茶山。

translations.literal: Aixing'a ordered Ba'erhetu and others to select elite troops and gallop more than three hundred li to the riverbank; Wenxuan had already destroyed the bridge and fled to Chashan.
translations.idiomatic: Aixing'a ordered Ba'erhetu and others to pick elite troops and ride more than three hundred li to the river. Wenxuan had already destroyed the bridge and fled to Chashan.

sentences.zh: 大軍至，結筏以濟，遣總兵馬寧、沈應時追之。

translations.literal: When the main army arrived, they built rafts to cross and sent regional commanders Ma Ning and Shen Yingshi in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived it rafted across and sent regional commanders Ma Ning and Shen Yingshi in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 愛星阿與三桂督師趨緬甸，時緬甸酋盡殺桂王從官天波以下數十人，密使人守之，謀擒以歸我師。

translations.literal: Aixing'a and Sangui supervised the army toward Burma; at that time the Burmese chief had secretly killed dozens of the Prince of Gui's followers from Tianbo downward and sent men to guard him, plotting to deliver him to our army.
translations.idiomatic: Aixing'a and Sangui led the army toward Burma. The Burmese chief had secretly killed dozens of the Prince of Gui's followers from Tianbo downward, kept the prince under guard, and plotted to hand him to our army.

sentences.zh: 十二月，師次舊晚坡，去其庭六十里，緬甸使詣軍前請遣兵薄城，當以桂王獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the army halted at Jiuwanpo, sixty li from the Burmese court; a Burmese envoy came before the army and asked that troops be sent to press close to the city, saying the Prince of Gui would then be delivered.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the army halted at Jiuwanpo, sixty li from the Burmese court. A Burmese envoy asked that troops be sent to press the city, promising to deliver the Prince of Gui.

sentences.zh: 愛星阿遣白爾赫圖將前鋒百人進，次蘭鳩江濱；

translations.literal: Aixing'a sent Ba'erhetu to lead one hundred vanguard troops forward, and they halted on the bank of the Lanjiu River;
translations.idiomatic: Aixing'a sent Ba'erhetu forward with one hundred vanguard troops, halting on the bank of the Lanjiu River;

sentences.zh: 復令畢力克圖等將護軍二百人繼其後，緬甸以舟載桂王及其孥並故從官妻女獻軍前。

translations.literal: He again ordered Biliketu and others to lead two hundred guards to follow after them; Burma delivered the Prince of Gui with his wife and children and the wives and daughters of his former followers by boat before the army.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered Biliketu and others to follow with two hundred guards. Burma brought the Prince of Gui, his family, and the wives and daughters of his former followers by boat to the army.

sentences.zh: 寧、應時追文選及於猛養，文選度不能脫，遂降。

translations.literal: Ning and Yingshi pursued Wenxuan as far as Mengyang; Wenxuan saw he could not escape and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ning and Shen Yingshi pursued Wenxuan to Mengyang; seeing no escape, Wenxuan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 定國走死猛獵。

translations.literal: Dingguo fled and died at Menglie.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo fled and died at Menglie.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，聖祖諭嘉獎，命以愛星阿所俘獲畀三桂區處，振旅還京師。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, the Shengzu issued words of praise and reward, ordered that what Aixing'a had captured be turned over to Sangui for disposition, and the army returned in triumph to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On report of victory the Shengzu praised and rewarded him, ordered Aixing'a's captives turned over to Sangui for disposition, and the army returned in triumph to the capital.

sentences.zh: 加太保兼太子太保，敕書增紀軍功。

translations.literal: He was made grand tutor and concurrently grand tutor of the heir apparent; an imperial letter added a record of his military merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was made grand tutor and grand tutor of the heir apparent; an imperial letter recorded his military merit.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年二月，卒，諡敬康。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Kangxi he died; his posthumous title was Jingkang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second month of Kangxi 3 and was posthumously titled Jingkang.

sentences.zh: 子富善，襲。

translations.literal: His son Fushan inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fushan inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed chief grand minister of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief grand minister of the guard.

sentences.zh: 聖祖親征噶爾丹，富善將鑲紅旗兵扈上出中路，進次克魯倫河，閱選駝馬，徵輸芻粟，皆當上意。

translations.literal: When the Shengzu personally campaigned against Galdan, Fushan led Bordered Red Banner troops to escort the emperor on the central route, advanced and halted at the Kerulen River, inspected and selected camels and horses, and requisitioned fodder and grain—all to the emperor's satisfaction.
translations.idiomatic: On the Shengzu's personal campaign against Galdan, Fushan led Bordered Red Banner troops to escort the emperor on the central route. At the Kerulen River he inspected camels and horses and requisitioned fodder and grain—all to the emperor's satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 師還，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was made grand tutor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was made grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，追諡恭懿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong his posthumous title was posthumously changed to Gongyi.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong his posthumous title was revised to Gongyi.

sentences.zh: 遜塔，滿洲鑲藍旗人，安費揚古孫也。

translations.literal: Xunta was a man of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and a grandson of Amba Beile Eifu.
translations.idiomatic: Xunta was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner and a grandson of Amba Beile Eifu.

sentences.zh: 父碩爾輝。

translations.literal: His father was Suo'erhui.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Suo'erhui.

sentences.zh: 安費揚古既卒，太祖以所屬人戶分編牛錄，授碩爾輝牛錄額真。

translations.literal: After Eifu died, the Taizu divided the households that had belonged to him into niru and appointed Suo'erhui niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: After Eifu died, the Taizu reorganized his households into niru and appointed Suo'erhui niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 卒，遜塔嗣。

translations.literal: When he died, Xunta succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: On his death Xunta succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘉其能，予世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: The Taizong praised his ability and granted him the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizong praised his ability and granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授戶部副理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed vice director of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he was appointed vice director of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 是冬伐明，貝勒岳託將右翼自牆子嶺入邊，遜塔署甲喇額真，從噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦席特庫等擊破明總督吳阿衡軍，遂越明都，略山東。

translations.literal: That winter, campaigning against Ming, Prince Yoto commanded the right wing entering the frontier by way of Qiangziling; Xunta served as acting jalan ejen and with gabushiyan gala angbang Xitekui and others defeated the army of Ming governor Wu Aheng, then passed the Ming capital and overran Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on campaign against the Ming, Prince Yoto led the right wing in at Qiangziling. Acting as jalan ejen, Xunta with gabushiyan gala angbang Xitekui and others routed Ming governor Wu Aheng's army, passed the Ming capital, and overran Shandong.

sentences.zh: 明年春，師出邊，明兵躡我後，遜塔從巴牙喇纛章京圖賴等奮戰卻之。

translations.literal: The next spring, as the army left the frontier, Ming troops followed our rear; Xunta with bayara da janggin Tului and others fought fiercely and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring, as the army withdrew, Ming troops trailed the rear. Xunta with bayara da janggin Tului and others fought hard and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 明兵侵喀喇沁營，遜塔移兵赴援，明兵潰走。

translations.literal: Ming troops attacked the Kharachin camp; Xunta shifted troops to the rescue and the Ming army broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming troops attacked the Kharachin camp, Xunta moved to relieve it and the Ming army fled.

sentences.zh: 六年，圍錦州，明總督洪承疇赴援，屯松山，遜塔與甲喇額真藍拜率兵擊之，破三壘。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he besieged Jinzhou; Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou came to relieve the city and encamped at Songshan; Xunta with jalan ejen Lanbai led troops to attack and broke three fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he besieged Jinzhou. When Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou came to relieve the city and encamped at Songshan, Xunta with jalan ejen Lanbai attacked and broke three fortifications.

sentences.zh: 明兵乘陰雨犯我師右翼，復與藍拜步戰卻敵。

translations.literal: Ming troops took advantage of rain to strike our army's right wing; he again fought on foot with Lanbai and drove the enemy off.
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops exploited rainy weather to strike our right wing; he again fought on foot with Lanbai and repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 八年，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，破李自成，進世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the pass, defeated Li Zicheng, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he entered the pass, defeated Li Zicheng, and was raised to third-rank jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 三年，從大將軍肅親王豪格西討張獻忠，道漢中，與固山額真巴哈納等擊破叛將賀珍，進次西充。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the great general Prince Haoge of Su in the western campaign against Zhang Xianzhong, passed through Hanzhong, and with gushan ejen Bahana and others defeated the rebel general He Zhen and advanced to Xichong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed the great general Prince Haoge of Su west against Zhang Xianzhong, passed Hanzhong, and with gushan ejen Bahana and others defeated rebel general He Zhen and advanced to Xichong.

sentences.zh: 獻忠率其徒拒戰，遜塔與固山額真李國翰等迭擊破之。

translations.literal: Xianzhong led his followers to resist; Xunta with gushan ejen Li Guohan and others repeatedly attacked and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong led his followers to resist; Xunta with gushan ejen Li Guohan and others repeatedly routed them.

sentences.zh: 五年，師還，兼任刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the army returned, he concurrently served as director of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the army's return, he concurrently served as director of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 命率師駐防淮安。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead troops to garrison Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to garrison Huai'an with his troops.

sentences.zh: 六年，莒州土寇曹良臣破海州，知州張懋勳、州同李士麟死之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the local bandit Cao Liangchen of Juzhou broke Haizhou; prefect Zhang Maoxun and assistant prefect Li Shilin died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Juzhou bandit Cao Liangchen stormed Haizhou; Prefect Zhang Maoxun and Assistant Prefect Li Shilin were killed.

sentences.zh: 遜塔督兵赴援，良臣走保馬髻山，進擊破之。

translations.literal: Xunta led troops to the rescue; Liangchen fled to hold Maji Mountain, and an advance attack broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Xunta marched to relieve the city; Liangchen fled to Maji Mountain and was defeated in the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 時設浙淮鹽務理事、兼戶部侍郎銜，上以命遜塔，駐揚州。

translations.literal: At that time he was appointed to manage Zhejiang-Huai salt affairs with the concurrent rank of vice minister of the Board of Revenue and was stationed at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed to manage Zhejiang-Huai salt with the concurrent rank of vice minister of the Board of Revenue and stationed at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年，改督理漕運戶部侍郎，仍駐淮安。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was changed to vice minister of the Board of Revenue supervising grain transport and remained stationed at Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became vice minister of the Board of Revenue supervising grain transport, still based at Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 八年，官裁，遜塔還京，授鑲藍旗滿洲梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the office was abolished; Xunta returned to the capital and was appointed meirei ejen of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the office was abolished; Xunta returned to the capital and was made meirei ejen of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，進世職三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: On an amnesty edict his hereditary rank was advanced to third-rank ashan i ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: On an amnesty edict he was raised to third-rank ashan i ha'an.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 十五年，監修壇殿工成，進世職二等。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, when supervision of the altar and hall construction was completed, his hereditary rank was advanced to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, when the altar and hall construction he supervised was finished, his hereditary rank was raised to second rank.

sentences.zh: 尋兼授鑲藍旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was concurrently appointed Mongol gushan ejen of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon also made Mongol gushan ejen of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十七年，罷尚書，專任都統。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was dismissed as minister and served solely as dutong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was dismissed as minister and served only as dutong.

sentences.zh: 旋命從定西大將軍愛星阿率師下雲南，明年十一月，會師木邦，趨緬甸，得明桂王以歸。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to follow the general who pacifies the west, Aixing'a, in leading the army down into Yunnan; in the eleventh month of the next year the armies joined at Mubang, pressed into Burma, and brought back the Ming Prince of Gui.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to follow General Aixing'a into Yunnan; in the eleventh month of the following year the armies united at Mubang, marched into Burma, and brought back the Ming Prince of Gui.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進世職一等拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to first-rank tosoro ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was raised to first-rank tosoro ha'an.

sentences.zh: 四年，調本旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Manchu dutong of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to Manchu dutong of his banner.

sentences.zh: 十二月，卒，諡忠襄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he died; his posthumous title was Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth month and was posthumously titled Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 子馬錫泰，襲世職，授佐領，兼前鋒參領。

translations.literal: His son Maxitai inherited the hereditary rank, was appointed an assistant commandant, and concurrently served as vanguard lieutenant colonel.
translations.idiomatic: His son Maxitai inherited the hereditary rank, became an assistant commandant, and concurrently served as vanguard lieutenant colonel.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，從信郡王鄂札徵察哈爾布爾尼，師次達祿，布爾尼屯山岡，列火器拒戰，馬錫泰率前鋒薄險，四戰皆捷，進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign he followed Prince Ezha of Xin in campaigning against the Chahar Bulwani; the army halted at Dalu; Bulwani held a hill, arrayed firearms, and resisted; Maxitai led the vanguard to press the difficult ground, won four battles in succession, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-rank jingkini ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi reign he followed Prince Ezha of Xin against the Chahar Bulwani. At Dalu, Bulwani held the heights with firearms; Maxitai led the vanguard through the difficult ground, won four battles in succession, and was raised to third-rank jingkini ha'an.

sentences.zh: 又從討吳三桂，遷本旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: He again followed the campaign against Wu Sangui and was transferred to vice dutong of his banner's Manchu force.
translations.idiomatic: He later joined the campaign against Wu Sangui and became vice dutong of his banner's Manchu force.

sentences.zh: 自湖廣出廣西，下雲南，石門坎、黃草壩諸戰，皆在行間。

translations.literal: From Huguang he entered Guangxi, descended on Yunnan, and fought at Shimenkan, Huangcaba, and other engagements—all in the front line.
translations.idiomatic: From Huguang he entered Guangxi and Yunnan, fighting at Shimenkan, Huangcaba, and elsewhere in the front ranks.

sentences.zh: 進破雲南省城，逐賊楚雄，降三桂將馬寶、巴養元等。

translations.literal: He advanced and broke the Yunnan provincial capital, pursued the rebels to Chuxiong, and accepted the surrender of Sangui's generals Ma Bao and Ba Yangyuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed the Yunnan provincial capital, pursued the rebels to Chuxiong, and received the surrender of Sangui's generals Ma Bao, Ba Yangyuan, and others.

sentences.zh: 師還，進世職一等。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his hereditary rank was advanced to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned his hereditary rank was raised to first rank.

sentences.zh: 卒，孫德彝，降襲一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He died; his grandson Deyi inherited with reduced rank as first-rank ashan i ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: On his death his grandson Deyi inherited with reduction to first-rank ashan i ha'an.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong the fixed title was declared first-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong the noble title was fixed as first-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 都爾德，亦安費揚古孫。

translations.literal: Duerde was also a grandson of Eifu.
translations.idiomatic: Duerde was also a grandson of Eifu.

sentences.zh: 父阿爾岱，以牛彔額眞事太宗，駐耀州，禦明兵有功。

translations.literal: His father A'erdai, as niru ejen serving the Taizong, was stationed at Yaozhou and had merit in repelling Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: His father A'erdai served the Taizong as niru ejen at Yaozhou and had merit repelling Ming troops.

sentences.zh: 從攻大凌河，戰死，贈世職備禦，都爾德襲。

translations.literal: Following the attack on Dalinghe he died in battle; he was posthumously granted the hereditary rank of beye; Duerde inherited it.
translations.idiomatic: He died fighting at Dalinghe and was posthumously granted the hereditary rank of beye; Duerde inherited it.

sentences.zh: 順治初，授刑部理事官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he was appointed director of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi he was appointed director of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 從入關，擊李自成，署巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: Following the entry into the pass he attacked Li Zicheng and served as acting bayara da janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the pass he fought Li Zicheng and served as acting bayara da janggin.

sentences.zh: 從豫親王多鐸西征，戰陝州，督兵陟山拔其壘，復破敵潼關。

translations.literal: Following Prince Dorgon of Yu on the western campaign, he fought at Shaanzhou, led troops up the mountain and took the fortifications, and again defeated the enemy at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Following Prince Dorgon of Yu west, he fought at Shaanzhou, stormed the heights, and again defeated the enemy at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 尋自河南下江南，逐明福王由崧至蕪湖，截江而戰，大敗之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he descended from Henan into Jiangnan, pursued the Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong to Wuhu, intercepted them on the river, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He then came down from Henan into Jiangnan, pursued the Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong to Wuhu, fought on the river, and routed him.

sentences.zh: 復從端重親王博洛定浙江，徇福建，偕巴牙喇纛章京阿濟格尼堪攻汀州，破明唐王聿鍵。

translations.literal: He again followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo in settling Zhejiang, campaigning in Fujian, and with bayara da janggin Ajigenikan attacking Tingzhou and breaking the Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo in pacifying Zhejiang and Fujian and, with bayara da janggin Ajigenikan, attacked Tingzhou and broke the Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian.

sentences.zh: 復從鄭親王濟爾哈朗略湖廣，討李自成餘黨李錦等。

translations.literal: He again followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng in overrunning Huguang and suppressing the remnants of Li Zicheng's followers such as Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng through Huguang against Li Zicheng's remaining followers such as Li Jin.

sentences.zh: 師還，眞除巴牙喇纛章京，授議政大臣，世職累進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was formally appointed bayara da janggin, made a deliberative minister, and his hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to first-rank ashan i ha'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was confirmed as bayara da janggin, made a deliberative minister, and raised to first-rank ashan i ha'an.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，卒，賜祭葬，諡忠襄。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he died; he was granted sacrificial rites and burial; his posthumous title was Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 3, was granted state funeral rites, and was posthumously titled Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 論曰：順治初，取福、唐二王，不再期而定。

translations.literal: The commentary says: At the beginning of Shunzhi, taking the Princes of Fu and Tang required no more than one season to settle.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: At the start of Shunzhi the Princes of Fu and Tang were taken in little more than a season.

sentences.zh: 桂王勢更蹙，以有闖、獻餘眾死寇力戰，支拄十餘年。

translations.literal: The Prince of Gui's position was even more desperate, yet with the remnant forces of Li and Zhang fighting to the death he held out for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Gui was in even direr straits, yet with Li and Zhang's remnant armies fighting to the death he held out for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 陳泰定湖北，兵力至常、岳，阿爾津繼之，奄有湖南。

translations.literal: Chen Tai settled Hubei and his forces reached Chang and Yue; A'erjin succeeded him and swiftly possessed Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tai pacified Hubei and reached Changde and Yuezhou; A'erjin followed and quickly held Hunan.

sentences.zh: 李國翰略四川、貴州，卓布泰下雲南，卓羅從信郡王為之佐；

translations.literal: Li Guohan overran Sichuan and Guizhou, Zhuobutai descended on Yunnan, and Zhuoluo followed Prince Duo Ni as his assistant;
translations.idiomatic: Li Guohan overran Sichuan and Guizhou, Zhuobutai took Yunnan, and Zhuoluo served under Prince Duo Ni;

sentences.zh: 愛星阿繼之，遜塔為之佐；

translations.literal: Aixing'a succeeded him, with Xunta as his assistant;
translations.idiomatic: Aixing'a succeeded them, with Xunta as his assistant;

sentences.zh: 與吳三桂合軍，深入緬甸取桂王：明宗至是始盡熸矣。

translations.literal: Joining with Wu Sangui, they marched deep into Burma and took the Prince of Gui: the Ming imperial line was at last wholly extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Uniting with Wu Sangui, they marched deep into Burma and captured the Prince of Gui—the Ming imperial line was extinguished at last.
